sthirāṇi madhyamānyeṣāṃ madhyanāgacatuṣpadau //
1.56.d:
कट्यामुन्मत्तता नाभौ च्युतिः पुच्छे ध्रुवं जयः ।
स्थिराणि मध्यमान्येषां मध्यनागचतुष्पदौ ॥
1.56.m: in the waist, madness; in the navel, downfall; in the tail, victory is certain. / The fixed ones among these are middling; in the middle are Nāga and Catuṣpad.

1.56.s:
divāmuhūrtā rudrāhimitrapitṛvasūdakam /
viśvevidhātṛbrahmendrarudrāgnivasutoyapāḥ //
1.56.d:
दिवामुहूर्ता रुद्राहिमित्रपितृवसूदकम् ।
विश्वेविधातृब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्राग्निवसुतोयपाः ॥
1.56.m: The daytime muhūrtas are: Rudra, Ahi, Mitra, Pitṛ, Vasu, Udaka, / Viśvedevas, Vidhātṛ, Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, Agni, Vasu, Toyapa,

1.56.s:
aryamā bhagasaṃjñaśca vijñeyā daśa pañca ca /
īśājapādāhirbudhnyapūṣāśviyamavahnayaḥ //
1.56.d:
अर्यमा भगसंज्ञश्च विज्ञेया दश पञ्च च ।
ईशाजपादाहिर्बुध्न्यपूषाश्वियमवह्नयः ॥
1.56.m: Aryaman, and the one named Bhaga—these fifteen are to be known. / [The night muhūrtas are:] Īśa, Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Pūṣan, the two Aśvins, Yama, Agni,

1.56.s:
dhātṛ indrāditījyākhyā viṣṇvarkatvaṣṭṛvāyavaḥ /
ahnaḥ pañcadaśo bhāgastathā rātripramāṇataḥ //
1.56.d:
धातृ इन्द्रादितीज्याख्या विष्ण्वर्कत्वष्टृवायवः ।
अह्नः पञ्चदशो भागस्तथा रात्रिप्रमाणतः ॥
1.56.m: Dhātṛ, Indra, Aditi, Bṛhaspati, Viṣṇu, Arka, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Vāyu. / The fifteenth part of the day, and likewise of the duration of the night,

1.56.s:
muhūrtamānaṃ dvarāvakṣaṇarkṣāṇi sameśvaram /
aryamā rākṣasabrāhnau pitryāgneyau tathābhijit //
1.56.d:
मुहूर्तमानं द्वरावक्षणर्क्षाणि समेश्वरम् ।
अर्यमा राक्षसब्राह्नौ पित्र्याग्नेयौ तथाभिजित् ॥
1.56.m: is the measure of a muhūrta, containing asterisms of two twinkling-moments with their respective lords. / Aryaman, Rākṣasa, and Brāhma; the two Pitrya and Āgneya; likewise Abhijit;

1.56.s:
rākṣasākhyau brāhmapitryau bhargājāṃśāvalinādiṣu /
vāreṣu varjanīyāste muhūrtāḥ śubhakarmasu //
1.56.d:
राक्षसाख्यौ ब्राह्मपित्र्यौ भर्गाजांशावलिनादिषु ।
वारेषु वर्जनीयास्ते मुहूर्ताः शुभकर्मसु ॥
1.56.m: the two called Rākṣasa, Brāhma, and Pitrya, on the days of Bharga, Aja, Aṃśumat, and Bali and the like— / these muhūrtas are to be avoided in auspicious actions on those days.

1.56.s:
yeṣu ṛkṣeṣu yatkarma kathitaṃ nikhilaṃ ca tat /
taddaivatye muhūrte 'pi kāryaṃ yātrādikaṃ sadā //
1.56.d:
येषु ऋक्षेषु यत्कर्म कथितं निखिलं च तत् ।
तद्दैवत्ये मुहूर्ते ऽपि कार्यं यात्रादिकं सदा ॥
1.56.m: Whatever rite has been declared in any asterisms, all of that / may always be undertaken in the muhūrta presided over by that same deity, such as a journey.

1.56.s:
bhūkaṃpaḥ sūryabhātsaptamarkṣe vidyuñca pañcame /
śūlo 'ṣṭame ca daśame śāniraṣṭādaśe tataḥ //
1.56.d:
भूकंपः सूर्यभात्सप्तमर्क्षे विद्युञ्च पञ्चमे ।
शूलो ऽष्टमे च दशमे शानिरष्टादशे ततः ॥
1.56.m: An earthquake occurs in the seventh asterism from the Sun's asterism, and lightning in the fifth; / a comet in the eighth, Saturn in the tenth, and then in the eighteenth.

1.56.s:
ketuḥ pañcadaśe daṇḍa ulkā ekonaviṃśatau /
nirghātapātasaṃjñaśca jñeyaḥ sa navapañcame //
1.56.d:
केतुः पञ्चदशे दण्ड उल्का एकोनविंशतौ ।
निर्घातपातसंज्ञश्च ज्ञेयः स नवपञ्चमे ॥
1.56.m: Ketu is in the fifteenth; Daṇḍa and Ulkā in the nineteenth; / and the one named Nirghātapāta should be known in the ninth and fifth.

1.56.s:
mohanirghātakaṃ pāśca kuliśaṃ pariveṣaṇam /
vijñeyā ekaviṃśarkṣādārabhya ca yathākramam //
1.56.d:
मोहनिर्घातकं पाश्च कुलिशं परिवेषणम् ।
विज्ञेया एकविंशर्क्षादारभ्य च यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.56.m: Moha, Nirghātaka, Pāśa, Kuliśa, and Pariveṣaṇa / should be known in order, beginning from the twenty-first asterism.

1.56.s:
candrayukteṣu bheṣveṣu śubhakarma na kārayet /
sūryabhātsarvapitryarkṣaṃ tvāṣṭramitraptabheṣu ca //
1.56.d:
चन्द्रयुक्तेषु भेष्वेषु शुभकर्म न कारयेत् ।
सूर्यभात्सर्वपित्र्यर्क्षं त्वाष्ट्रमित्रप्तभेषु च ॥
1.56.m: When the Moon is conjoined with these asterisms, one should not perform any auspicious rite. / From the Sun's asterism, all the asterisms sacred to the Pitṛs, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Mitra,

1.56.s:
saviṣaaṇubheṣu kramaśo hastabhāñcandrasaṃyutaḥ /
dhiṣṇye tāvati satyatra duṣṭayogaḥ patatyasau //
1.56.d:
सविषअणुभेषु क्रमशो हस्तभाञ्चन्द्रसंयुतः ।
धिष्ण्ये तावति सत्यत्र दुष्टयोगः पतत्यसौ ॥
1.56.m: and the asterisms Viśākhā and Anurādhā respectively, when conjoined with the Moon from the Hasta asterism: / when the Moon is in such an asterism, this inauspicious combination occurs.

1.56.s:
caṇḍīśacaṇḍāyudhākhyastasminnaivācarecchubham /
trayodaśa syurmilanasaṃkhyayā tithivārayoḥ //
1.56.d:
चण्डीशचण्डायुधाख्यस्तस्मिन्नैवाचरेच्छुभम् ।
त्रयोदश स्युर्मिलनसंख्यया तिथिवारयोः ॥
1.56.m: It is named Caṇḍīśa and Caṇḍāyudha; during it, one must not perform any auspicious act. / There are thirteen [such yogas] by the reckoning of the conjunctions of lunar day and weekday.

1.56.s:
krakaco nāma yogo 'yaṃ maṅgaleṣvatigardditaḥ /
saptamyāmarkavāraścetpratipatsaumyabāsare //
1.56.d:
क्रकचो नाम योगो ऽयं मङ्गलेष्वतिगर्द्दितः ।
सप्तम्यामर्कवारश्चेत्प्रतिपत्सौम्यबासरे ॥
1.56.m: This yoga called Krakaca is severely condemned in auspicious rites: / if there is Sunday on the seventh lunar day, or Wednesday on the first lunar day,

1.56.s:
saṃvatayogo vijñeyaḥ śubhakarmavināśakṛt /
ānandaḥ kāladaṇḍākhyo dhūmradhātṛsudhākarāḥ //
1.56.d:
संवतयोगो विज्ञेयः शुभकर्मविनाशकृत् ।
आनन्दः कालदण्डाख्यो धूम्रधातृसुधाकराः ॥
1.56.m:
It is to be known as saṃvatayoga, which destroys auspicious undertakings.
Ānanda, the one called Kāladaṇḍa, Dhūmra, Dhātṛ, Sudhākāra,

1.56.s:
dhvāṅkṣadhvajākhyaśrīvatsavajramudgarachatrakāḥ /
mitramānasapadmākhyalumbakotpātamṛtyavaḥ //
1.56.d:
ध्वाङ्क्षध्वजाख्यश्रीवत्सवज्रमुद्गरछत्रकाः ।
मित्रमानसपद्माख्यलुम्बकोत्पातमृत्यवः ॥
1.56.m:
Dhvāṅkṣa, the one named Dhvaja, Śrīvatsa, Vajra, Mudgara, Chatraka,
Mitra, Mānasa, the one called Padma, Lumbaka, Utpāta, Mṛtyu,

1.56.s:
kāṇasiddhiśubhā mṛtyumuśalāntakarkujarāḥ /
rākṣasākhyavarasthairyavarddhamānāḥ kramādamī //
1.56.d:
काणसिद्धिशुभा मृत्युमुशलान्तकर्कुजराः ।
राक्षसाख्यवरस्थैर्यवर्द्धमानाः क्रमादमी ॥
1.56.m:
Kāṇa, Siddhi, Śubha, Mṛtyu, Musala, Antaka, Gaja,
the one named Rākṣasa, Vara, Sthairya, and Vardhamāna: in this order,

1.56.s:
yogāḥ svasaṃjñāphaladā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥ /
ravivāre kramādeva dasrabhārdidubhādvidhau //
1.56.d:
योगाः स्वसंज्ञाफलदा अष्टाविंशतिरीरिताः ।
रविवारे क्रमादेव दस्रभार्दिदुभाद्विधौ ॥
1.56.m:
these twenty-eight yogas are proclaimed, granting fruits corresponding to their own names.
On Sunday, [they begin] precisely in sequence from Aśvinī; on Monday, from Mṛgaśīrṣa;

1.56.s:
sārpāddhaume pudhe hastānmaitrabhātsuramantriṇi /
vaiśvadevādbhagusute vāruṇādbhāskarātmaje //
1.56.d:
सार्पाद्धौमे पुधे हस्तान्मैत्रभात्सुरमन्त्रिणि ।
वैश्वदेवाद्भगुसुते वारुणाद्भास्करात्मजे ॥
1.56.m:
on Tuesday, from Āśleṣā; on Wednesday, from Hasta; on Thursday, from Anurādhā;
on Friday, from Uttarāṣāḍhā; and on Saturday, from Śatabhiṣaj.

1.56.s:
hastarkṣaṃ ca khārvidau candrabhaṃ dasrabhaṃ kuje /
saumye mitrabhamācāryaṃ tiṣyaḥ pauṣṇaṃ bhṛgoḥ sute //
1.56.d:
हस्तर्क्षं च खार्विदौ चन्द्रभं दस्रभं कुजे ।
सौम्ये मित्रभमाचार्यं तिष्यः पौष्णं भृगोः सुते ॥
1.56.m:
Hasta and Puṣya on Monday; Citrā and Aśvinī on Tuesday;
Anurādhā on Wednesday; Puṣya on Thursday; Revatī on Friday;

1.56.s:
/
rohiṇī mandavāre ca siddhiyogāhvayā amī /
ādityabhaumayornandā bhadrā śukraśaśāṅkayoḥ //
1.56.d:
।
रोहिणी मन्दवारे च सिद्धियोगाह्वया अमी ।
आदित्यभौमयोर्नन्दा भद्रा शुक्रशशाङ्कयोः ॥
1.56.m:
and Rohiṇī on Saturday—these are called siddhi-yogas.
Nandā on Sunday and Tuesday; Bhadrā on Friday and Monday;

1.56.s:
jayāsaumye gurau riktā śanaupūrṇeti no śubhāḥ /
nandā tithiḥ śukravāre saumye bhadrā kuje jayā //
1.56.d:
जयासौम्ये गुरौ रिक्ता शनौपूर्णेति नो शुभाः ।
नन्दा तिथिः शुक्रवारे सौम्ये भद्रा कुजे जया ॥
1.56.m:
Jayā on Wednesday; Riktā on Thursday; Pūrṇā on Saturday: these are inauspicious.
The tithi Nandā on Friday, Bhadrā on Wednesday, Jayā on Tuesday,

1.56.s:
riktā mande gurorvāre pūrṇā siddhāhvayā amī /
ekādaśyāminduvāro dvādaśyāmarkavāsaraḥ //
1.56.d:
रिक्ता मन्दे गुरोर्वारे पूर्णा सिद्धाह्वया अमी ।
एकादश्यामिन्दुवारो द्वादश्यामर्कवासरः ॥
1.56.m:
Riktā on Saturday, and Pūrṇā on Thursday: these are named siddhā.
Monday on the eleventh [tithi]; Sunday on the twelfth;

1.56.s:
ṣaṣṭī gurau tṛtīyā jñe 'ṣṭamī śukre śanaiścare /
navamī pañcamī bhaume dagdhayogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
1.56.d:
षष्टी गुरौ तृतीया ज्ञे ऽष्टमी शुक्रे शनैश्चरे ।
नवमी पञ्चमी भौमे दग्धयोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
1.56.m:
the sixth on Thursday; the third on Wednesday; the eighth on Friday;
the ninth on Saturday; and the fifth on Tuesday are proclaimed as the dagdha-yogas.

1.56.s:
bharaṇyarkadine candre citrābhaumetu viśvabham /
budhe śraviṣṭāryamabhe gurau jyeṣṭā bhṛgordine //
1.56.d:
भरण्यर्कदिने चन्द्रे चित्राभौमेतु विश्वभम् ।
बुधे श्रविष्टार्यमभे गुरौ ज्येष्टा भृगोर्दिने ॥
1.56.m:
Bharaṇī on Sunday; Citrā on Monday; Uttarāṣāḍhā on Tuesday;
Śraviṣṭhā on Wednesday; Uttaraphālgunī on Thursday; Jyeṣṭhā on Friday;

1.56.s:
revatī mandavāre tu grahajanmarkṣanāśanam /
viśākhādicaturvargamarkamarkavārādiṣu kramāt //
1.56.d:
रेवती मन्दवारे तु ग्रहजन्मर्क्षनाशनम् ।
विशाखादिचतुर्वर्गमर्कमर्कवारादिषु क्रमात् ॥
1.56.m:
and Revatī on Saturday destroy the natal constellation of planets.
The group of four beginning with Viśākhā, in order on the days beginning with Sunday,

1.56.s:
utpātamṛtyukāraṇākhyasiddhiyogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
tithivārodbhavā neṣṭā yogā vārarkṣasaṃbhavāḥ //
1.56.d:
उत्पातमृत्युकारणाख्यसिद्धियोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः ।
तिथिवारोद्भवा नेष्टा योगा वारर्क्षसंभवाः ॥
1.56.m:
are proclaimed as the yogas called Utpāta, Mṛtyu, Kāraṇa, and Siddhi.
Yogas arising from tithis and days are undesirable; yogas born of days and constellations,

1.56.s:
hūṇavaṅgakhaseṣvanyadeśeṣvatiśubhapradāḥ /
ghorāṣṭākṣīmahodaryo mandā mandākinī tathā //
1.56.d:
हूणवङ्गखसेष्वन्यदेशेष्वतिशुभप्रदाः ।
घोराष्टाक्षीमहोदर्यो मन्दा मन्दाकिनी तथा ॥
1.56.m:
[though undesirable] in the lands of the Hūṇas, Vaṅgas, and Khasas, are exceedingly auspicious in other regions.
Ghorā, Aṣṭākṣī, Mahodarī, Mandā, Mandākinī,

1.56.s:
miśrā rākṣasikā sūryavārādiṣu yathākramam /
śūdrataskaravaiśyakṣmādevabhūpagavāṃ kramāt //
1.56.d:
मिश्रा राक्षसिका सूर्यवारादिषु यथाक्रमम् ।
शूद्रतस्करवैश्यक्ष्मादेवभूपगवां क्रमात् ॥
1.56.m:
Miśrā, and Rākṣasikā, in respective order on the days beginning with Sunday,
are remembered as bringing happiness to Śūdras, thieves, Vaiśyas, Brāhmaṇas, kings, cows,

1.56.s:
anuktānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ghorādyāḥ sukhadāḥ smṛtāḥ /
pūrvāhne nṛpatīnhanti viprānmadhyandine viśaḥ //
1.56.d:
अनुक्तानां च सर्वेषां घोराद्याः सुखदाः स्मृताः ।
पूर्वाह्ने नृपतीन्हन्ति विप्रान्मध्यन्दिने विशः ॥
1.56.m:
and all those not explicitly mentioned, respectively.
In the forenoon, the sun's ingress destroys kings; at midday, Brāhmaṇas; in the afternoon, Vaiśyas;

1.56.s:
aparāhne 'stage śūdrānpradoṣe ca piśācakān /
niśi rātricarānnāṭyakārānapararātrike //
1.56.d:
अपराह्ने ऽस्तगे शूद्रान्प्रदोषे च पिशाचकान् ।
निशि रात्रिचरान्नाट्यकारानपररात्रिके ॥
1.56.m:
at sunset, Śūdras; in the early evening, piśācas;
at night, night-roaming spirits; in the latter part of the night, actors;

1.56.s:
gopānuṣasi saṃdhyāyāṃ liṅgino ravisaṃkramaḥ /
divā cenmeṣasaṃkrāntiranarthakalahapradā //
1.56.d:
गोपानुषसि संध्यायां लिङ्गिनो रविसंक्रमः ।
दिवा चेन्मेषसंक्रान्तिरनर्थकलहप्रदा ॥
1.56.m:
at dawn, cowherds; and at twilight, ascetics.
If the Aries saṃkrānti occurs during the day, it causes ruin and strife;

1.56.s:
rātrau subhikṣamatulaṃ saṃdhyayorvṛṣṭināśanam /
hariśārdūlavārāhakharakuñjaramāhiṣāḥ /
aśvaśpavājavṛṣāḥ pādāyudhāḥ karaṇavāhanāḥ //
1.56.d:
रात्रौ सुभिक्षमतुलं संध्ययोर्वृष्टिनाशनम् ।
हरिशार्दूलवाराहखरकुञ्जरमाहिषाः ।
अश्वश्पवाजवृषाः पादायुधाः करणवाहनाः ॥
1.56.m:
if at night, matchless abundance of food; and at both twilights, the destruction of rainfall.
Lion, tiger, boar, donkey, elephant, buffalo,

1.56.s: bhuśuḍī ca gadākhaḍgau daṇḍa iṣaavāsatomarau //
1.56.d: भुशुडी च गदाखड्गौ दण्ड इषअवासतोमरौ ॥
1.56.m:
horse, dog, goat, and bull are the footed vehicles of the karaṇas.
The bhuśuṇḍī, mace, sword, staff, arrow, spear, and javelin,

1.56.s:
kuntapāśāṅkuśāstreṣūnbibharti karayostvinaḥ /
annaṃ ca pāyasaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ sayūṣaṃ ca payo dadhi //
1.56.d:
कुन्तपाशाङ्कुशास्त्रेषून्बिभर्ति करयोस्त्विनः ।
अन्नं च पायसं भैक्ष्यं सयूषं च पयो दधि ॥
1.56.m:
lance, noose, goad, missile, and arrows: the sun bears these in his hands.
Boiled rice, milk-rice, alms-food, broth, milk, curds,

1.56.s:
miṣṭānnaṃ guḍamadhvājyaśarkarā vavato haviḥ /
vavovīvaṇijeviśvāṃ bālave gocarasthitau //
1.56.d:
मिष्टान्नं गुडमध्वाज्यशर्करा ववतो हविः ।
ववोवीवणिजेविश्वां बालवे गोचरस्थितौ ॥
1.56.m:
sweetmeats, molasses, honey, ghee, sugar, and sacrificial offering from Bava onwards [are the food].
Bava, Vālava, Kaulava, Taitila, Gara, Vaṇij, and Viṣṭi,

1.56.s:
kaulave śakunau bhānuḥ kiṃstughne corddhasaṃsthitathaḥ /
catuḥ pāde tilenāge suptaḥ krāntiṃ karoti hi //
1.56.d:
कौलवे शकुनौ भानुः किंस्तुघ्ने चोर्द्धसंस्थितथः ।
चतुः पादे तिलेनागे सुप्तः क्रान्तिं करोति हि ॥
1.56.m:
Śakuni, Catuṣpada, Kintughna, and Nāga: when situated upright,
seated, or sleeping, the sun makes his transit.

1.56.s:
dharmāyurvṛṣṭiṣu samaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naṣṭaṃ phalaṃ kramāt /
āyudhaṃ vāhanāhārau yajjātīyaṃ janasya ca //
1.56.d:
धर्मायुर्वृष्टिषु समं श्रेष्ठं नष्टं फलं क्रमात् ।
आयुधं वाहनाहारौ यज्जातीयं जनस्य च ॥
1.56.m:
Regarding virtue, lifespan, and rain, the fruit is middling, excellent, or ruined in order.
Whatever class of weapon, vehicle, and food belongs to people,

1.56.s:
svāpopaviṣṭāstiṣṭhantaste lokāḥ kṣemamāpnuyuḥ /
andhakaṃ mandasaṃjñaṃ ca madhyasaṃjñaṃ sulocanam //
1.56.d:
स्वापोपविष्टास्तिष्ठन्तस्ते लोकाः क्षेममाप्नुयुः ।
अन्धकं मन्दसंज्ञं च मध्यसंज्ञं सुलोचनम् ॥
1.56.m:
if those people are asleep, seated, or standing, they attain security.
Blind, slow-sighted, middle-sighted, and clear-sighted:

1.56.s:
papīyādgaṇayodbhāni rohiṇyādicaturvidham /
sthirabheṣvarkasaṃkrāntirjñeyā viṣṇupadāhvayā //
1.56.d:
पपीयाद्गणयोद्भानि रोहिण्यादिचतुर्विधम् ।
स्थिरभेष्वर्कसंक्रान्तिर्ज्ञेया विष्णुपदाह्वया ॥
1.56.m:
one should count the constellations from Rohiṇī onwards into these four classes.
The transit of the sun into fixed signs is known as Viṣṇupada;

1.56.s:
ṣaḍaśītimukhā jñeyā dvisvabhāveṣu rāśiṣu /
tulāghaṭājayorjñeyo viṣuvatsūryasaṃkramaḥ //
1.56.d:
षडशीतिमुखा ज्ञेया द्विस्वभावेषु राशिषु ।
तुलाघटाजयोर्ज्ञेयो विषुवत्सूर्यसंक्रमः ॥
1.56.m:
into dual signs, it is known as Ṣaḍaśītimukha.
The sun's transit into Libra and Aries is known as the equinox.

1.56.s:
yāmyāyane sthire tvādyāḥ parāḥ saumyendumūrtibhaiḥ /
medhyā viṣuvati proktāḥ puṇyanāḍyastu ṣoḍaśa //
1.56.d:
याम्यायने स्थिरे त्वाद्याः पराः सौम्येन्दुमूर्तिभैः ।
मेध्या विषुवति प्रोक्ताः पुण्यनाड्यस्तु षोडश ॥
1.56.m:
In the southern solstice and fixed signs, the earlier [nāḍīs] are pure; in the northern solstice and lunar signs, the later ones.
At the equinox, sixteen nāḍīs are declared auspicious.

1.56.s:
saṃdhyā trināḍī pramitārkabiṃborddhodayāstataḥ /
prākpaścādyāmyasaumye cetpuṇyaṃ pūrvāṃpare 'hani //
1.56.d:
संध्या त्रिनाडी प्रमितार्कबिंबोर्द्धोदयास्ततः ।
प्राक्पश्चाद्याम्यसौम्ये चेत्पुण्यं पूर्वांपरे ऽहनि ॥
1.56.m:
Twilight is measured as three nāḍīs from the rising and setting of the solar disc.
If before and after, in the southern or northern [course], the merit belongs to the previous or the next day.

1.56.s:
yādṛśenendunā bhānoḥ saṃkrāntistādṛśaṃ phalam /
naraḥ prāpnoti tadrāśau śītāṃśoḥ sādhvasādhu ca //
1.56.d:
यादृशेनेन्दुना भानोः संक्रान्तिस्तादृशं फलम् ।
नरः प्राप्नोति तद्राशौ शीतांशोः साध्वसाधु च ॥
1.56.m:
According to the condition of the moon at the sun's transit, a person
receives that kind of good or bad fruit in that sign of the moon.

1.56.s:
saṃkrānteḥ parato bhānurbhuktvā yāvadbhiraṃśakaiḥ /
raverayanasaṃkrāntistadā tadrāśisaṃkramāt //
1.56.d:
संक्रान्तेः परतो भानुर्भुक्त्वा यावद्भिरंशकैः ।
रवेरयनसंक्रान्तिस्तदा तद्राशिसंक्रमात् ॥
1.56.m:
Beyond the saṃkrānti, by however many degrees the sun has traversed,
when the solstitial ingress of the sun occurs, then it is from the ingress into that sign.

1.56.s:
sakrāntigrahagarkṣaṃvā janmanyubhayapārśvayoḥ /
vratodvāhādikeṣveva dvayaṃ neṣṭaṃ tu tatkramāt //
1.56.d:
सक्रान्तिग्रहगर्क्षंवा जन्मन्युभयपार्श्वयोः ।
व्रतोद्वाहादिकेष्वेव द्वयं नेष्टं तु तत्क्रमात् ॥
1.56.m:
The constellation of the transit or eclipse planet on either side of the natal constellation
is undesirable in observances, marriages, and the like, in that order.

1.56.s:
tiloparilikheccakraṃ tritriśūlaṃ trikoṇakam /
tatra hema vinikṣipya dadyāddoṣāpavṛttayeḥ //
1.56.d:
तिलोपरिलिखेच्चक्रं त्रित्रिशूलं त्रिकोणकम् ।
तत्र हेम विनिक्षिप्य दद्याद्दोषापवृत्तयेः ॥
1.56.m:
Upon sesame seeds, one should draw a triangular diagram with three tridents;
placing gold upon it, one should offer it to remove the defect.

1.56.s:
tārābalena śītāṃśurbalavāṃstadvaśādraviḥ /
balī saṃkramamāṇastu tadvatkheṭā balādhikāḥ //
1.56.d:
ताराबलेन शीतांशुर्बलवांस्तद्वशाद्रविः ।
बली संक्रममाणस्तु तद्वत्खेटा बलाधिकाः ॥
1.56.m:
The cool-rayed moon is strong through the strength of constellations; under his sway the sun
is strong when transiting, and likewise the planets have greater strength.

1.56.s:
śubhor'ke janmatastryāyadaśaṣaṭsu munīśvara /
navapañcāṃburiṣphasthairvyarkibhirvidhyate na cet //
1.56.d:
शुभोर्ऽके जन्मतस्त्र्यायदशषट्सु मुनीश्वर ।
नवपञ्चांबुरिष्फस्थैर्व्यर्किभिर्विध्यते न चेत् ॥
1.56.m:
The sun is auspicious in the third, eleventh, tenth, and sixth from the natal sign, O lord of sages,
if not obstructed by planets other than Saturn in the ninth, fifth, fourth, and twelfth.

1.56.s:
śubho janmarkṣataścandro dyūnāṅgāyārisvatriṣu /
yatheṣṭāntyāṃbudharmasthaivibudhairvidhyate na cet //
1.56.d:
शुभो जन्मर्क्षतश्चन्द्रो द्यूनाङ्गायारिस्वत्रिषु ।
यथेष्टान्त्यांबुधर्मस्थैविबुधैर्विध्यते न चेत् ॥
1.56.m:
The moon is auspicious from the natal constellation in the seventh, sixth, eleventh, tenth, second, and third,
if not obstructed by planets in the fifth, twelfth, fourth, and ninth.

1.56.s:
tryāyāriṣu kujaḥ śreṣṭho janmanā cenna vidhyate /
vyayeṣvaṅkasthitaiḥ saurisaumyasūryaiḥ śubhauṣadhāt //
1.56.d:
त्र्यायारिषु कुजः श्रेष्ठो जन्मना चेन्न विध्यते ।
व्ययेष्वङ्कस्थितैः सौरिसौम्यसूर्यैः शुभौषधात् ॥
1.56.m:
Mars is best in the third, eleventh, and sixth from the natal sign, if not obstructed
by Saturn, Mercury, and the sun located in the twelfth, fifth, and ninth.

1.56.s:
jñaḥ svāyāryaṣṭaravayiṣu janmataścenna vidhaayate /
dhītryakādigajāntasthaiḥ śaśāṅkarahitaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
1.56.d:
ज्ञः स्वायार्यष्टरवयिषु जन्मतश्चेन्न विधअयते ।
धीत्र्यकादिगजान्तस्थैः शशाङ्करहितैः शुभैः ॥
1.56.m:
Mercury is auspicious from the natal sign in the second, fourth, sixth, eighth, tenth, and eleventh, if not obstructed
by benefics excluding the moon in the fifth, third, ninth, first, eighth, and twelfth.

1.56.s:
janmarāśerguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svāyago 'dhyastago na cet /
vidhyatentyāṣṭaravāṃbutrigataiḥ ravaiṭairmunīśvarā //
1.56.d:
जन्मराशेर्गुरुः श्रेष्ठः स्वायगो ऽध्यस्तगो न चेत् ।
विध्यतेन्त्याष्टरवांबुत्रिगतैः रवैटैर्मुनीश्वरा ॥
1.56.m:
Jupiter is best in the second, eleventh, ninth, fifth, and seventh from the natal sign, if not
obstructed, O lord of sages, by planets in the twelfth, eighth, tenth, fourth, and third.

1.56.s:
janmabhādāsutāṣṭāṅkāntyāyeṣviṣṭo bhṛgoḥsutaḥ /
cenna viddho 'ṣṭasaptāṅgam ravāṅkādyāyārirāmagaiḥ //
1.56.d:
जन्मभादासुताष्टाङ्कान्त्यायेष्विष्टो भृगोःसुतः ।
चेन्न विद्धो ऽष्टसप्ताङ्गम् रवाङ्काद्यायारिरामगैः ॥
1.56.m:
Venus is favored from the natal constellation in the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, and eleventh,
if not obstructed by planets in the eighth, seventh, sixth, tenth, ninth, first, eleventh, sixth, and third.

1.56.s:
na dadāti śubhaṃ kiñcidgocare vedhasaṃyute /
tasmādvedhaṃ vicāryātha kathanīyaṃ śubhāśubham //
1.56.d:
न ददाति शुभं किञ्चिद्गोचरे वेधसंयुते ।
तस्माद्वेधं विचार्याथ कथनीयं शुभाशुभम् ॥
1.56.m:
When transit is attended with an obstruction, it grants no auspicious fruit at all;
therefore, only after considering the obstruction should good or bad be declared.

1.56.s:
vāmabhedavidhānena duṣṭo 'pi syācchubhaṅkaraḥ /
saumyekṣito 'niṣṭaphalaḥ śubhadaḥ pāpavīkṣitaḥ //
1.56.d:
वामभेदविधानेन दुष्टो ऽपि स्याच्छुभङ्करः ।
सौम्येक्षितो ऽनिष्टफलः शुभदः पापवीक्षितः ॥
1.56.m:
By reverse variation, even a malefic can become an auspicious maker;
aspected by a benefic it may yield undesirable fruit, and aspected by a malefic it may yield good fruit.

1.56.s:
niṣphalau tau grahau svena śatruṇā ca vilokitau /
nīcarāśigataḥ svasya śatroḥ kṣetragato 'pi vā //
1.56.d:
निष्फलौ तौ ग्रहौ स्वेन शत्रुणा च विलोकितौ ।
नीचराशिगतः स्वस्य शत्रोः क्षेत्रगतो ऽपि वा ॥
1.56.m:
Those two planets become fruitless when aspected by their own enemy,
or when fallen into a sign of debilitation or into the field of their enemy,

1.56.s:
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ naiva dadyādastamitopi vā /
graheṣu viṣamastheṣu śāntiṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ //
1.56.d:
शुभाशुभफलं नैव दद्यादस्तमितोपि वा ।
ग्रहेषु विषमस्थेषु शान्तिं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः ॥
1.56.m:
or when combust; they would not grant good or bad fruit at all.
When planets are adversely situated, one should diligently perform pacification.

1.56.s:
hānirvṛddhirgrahādhīnā tasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ /
maṇirmuktāphalaṃ vidrumākhyaṃ maraka taṃ tathā //
1.56.d:
हानिर्वृद्धिर्ग्रहाधीना तस्मात्पूज्यतमा ग्रहाः ।
मणिर्मुक्ताफलं विद्रुमाख्यं मरक तं तथा ॥
1.56.m:
Loss and gain depend on the planets; therefore, planets are most worthy of worship.
Ruby, pearl, coral, emerald,

1.56.s:
puṣparāgaṃ tathā vajraṃ nīlaṃ gomedasaṃjñitam /
dūryyaṃ bhāskarādīnāṃ tuṣṭya dhāryaṃ yathākramam //
1.56.d:
पुष्परागं तथा वज्रं नीलं गोमेदसंज्ञितम् ।
दूर्य्यं भास्करादीनां तुष्ट्य धार्यं यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.56.m:
topaz, diamond, sapphire, hessonite,
and cat's-eye should be worn respectively for the gratification of the sun and the others.

1.56.s:
śuklapakṣādidivase candro yasya śubhapradaḥ /
sa pakṣastasya śubhadaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣonyathāśubhaḥ //
1.56.d:
शुक्लपक्षादिदिवसे चन्द्रो यस्य शुभप्रदः ।
स पक्षस्तस्य शुभदः कृष्णपक्षोन्यथाशुभः ॥
1.56.m:
The person to whom the moon is auspicious on the first day of the bright fortnight,
to him that whole fortnight brings good; otherwise, the dark fortnight is inauspicious.

1.56.s:
śuklapakṣe śubhaścandro dvitīyanavapañcame /
riḥpharandhrāṃbusaṃsthaiścainna viddho gagane caraiḥ //
1.56.d:
शुक्लपक्षे शुभश्चन्द्रो द्वितीयनवपञ्चमे ।
रिःफरन्ध्रांबुसंस्थैश्चैन्न विद्धो गगने चरैः ॥
1.56.m: In the bright fortnight, the Moon is auspicious in the second, ninth, and fifth [houses], / provided it is not afflicted by celestial bodies situated in the twelfth, eighth, or fourth houses.

1.56.s:
janma saṃpadvipat kṣema pratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ /
mitraṃ paramamitraṃ ca janmabhāttu punaḥ puna //
1.56.d:
जन्म संपद्विपत् क्षेम प्रत्यरिः साधको वधः ।
मित्रं परममित्रं च जन्मभात्तु पुनः पुन ॥
1.56.m: Janma, Saṃpad, Vipat, Kṣema, Pratyari, Sādhaka, Vadha, / Mitra, and Parama-mitra [recur] again and again from the birth asterism.

1.56.s:
janmatripañcasaptākhyāstārā neṣṭa phalapradāḥ /
śākaṃ guḍaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ satilaṃ kāñcanaṃ kramāt //
1.56.d:
जन्मत्रिपञ्चसप्ताख्यास्तारा नेष्ट फलप्रदाः ।
शाकं गुडं च लवणं सतिलं काञ्चनं क्रमात् ॥
1.56.m: The asterisms called the birth, third, fifth, and seventh do not yield desirable fruits. / Vegetables, jaggery, salt, sesame seeds, and gold [should be offered] respectively,

1.56.s:
aniṣṭaphalanāśāya dadyādetaddvijātaye /
kṛṣṇe balavatī tārā śuklapakṣe balū śaśī /
candrasya dvādaśāvasthā rāśaurāśau yathākramam //
1.56.d:
अनिष्टफलनाशाय दद्यादेतद्द्विजातये ।
कृष्णे बलवती तारा शुक्लपक्षे बलू शशी ।
चन्द्रस्य द्वादशावस्था राशौराशौ यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.56.m: and given to a twice-born man to destroy inauspicious fruits. / In the dark fortnight the asterism is powerful; in the bright fortnight the Moon is powerful. / The Moon has twelve states in each sign in succession:

1.56.s:
yātrodvāhādikāryeṣu nāmatulyaphalapradāḥ /
ṣaṣṭighnaṃ gatacandrarkṣaṃ tatkālaghaṭikānvitam /
vedaghnamiṣuvedāntyamavasthā bhānubhāgataḥ //
1.56.d:
यात्रोद्वाहादिकार्येषु नामतुल्यफलप्रदाः ।
षष्टिघ्नं गतचन्द्रर्क्षं तत्कालघटिकान्वितम् ।
वेदघ्नमिषुवेदान्त्यमवस्था भानुभागतः ॥
1.56.m: In activities such as journeys and weddings, they grant results equal to their names. / Multiply the elapsed lunar asterism by sixty, add the current ghaṭikās, / multiply by four, and divide by forty-five: [the result is] the state from the Sun’s degree.

1.56.s:
pravāsanaṣṭākhyamṛtā jayo hāsyaṃ ratimudā /
śinibhuktirjvaraḥ kaṃpaḥ susthitirnāmasannibhāḥṛ //
1.56.d:
प्रवासनष्टाख्यमृता जयो हास्यं रतिमुदा ।
शिनिभुक्तिर्ज्वरः कंपः सुस्थितिर्नामसन्निभाःऋ ॥
1.56.m: Pravāsa, Naṣṭa, Mṛta, Jaya, Hāsya, Rati, Mudā, / Śubhā, Bhukti, Jvara, Kampa, and Susthiti correspond to their names.

1.56.s:
paṭṭabandhanayānograsaṃdhivigrahabhūṣaṇam /
dhātvākaraṃ yuddhakarma meṣalagne prasiddhyati //
1.56.d:
पट्टबन्धनयानोग्रसंधिविग्रहभूषणम् ।
धात्वाकरं युद्धकर्म मेषलग्ने प्रसिद्ध्यति ॥
1.56.m: Coronation, travel, harsh treaties and war, ornament, / metal mines, and acts of battle succeed in the Aries ascendant.

1.56.s:
maṅgalāni sthirāṇyaṃvuveśmakarmapravartanam /
kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvādiduṣṭalagne prasiddhyati //
1.56.d:
मङ्गलानि स्थिराण्यंवुवेश्मकर्मप्रवर्तनम् ।
कृषिवाणिज्यपश्वादिदुष्टलग्ने प्रसिद्ध्यति ॥
1.56.m: Fixed auspicious rites, waterworks, commencement of house building, / agriculture, trade, and cattle succeed in the Taurus ascendant.

1.56.s:
kalāvijñānaśilpāni bhūṣaṇāhavasaṃśravam /
gajodvāhābhiṣekādyaṃ karttavyaṃ mithunodaye //
1.56.d:
कलाविज्ञानशिल्पानि भूषणाहवसंश्रवम् ।
गजोद्वाहाभिषेकाद्यं कर्त्तव्यं मिथुनोदये ॥
1.56.m: Fine arts, sciences, crafts, ornament, battle alliances, / elephant-lore, wedding, and consecration should be performed at the rising of Gemini.

1.56.s:
vāpīkūpataḍāgādi vāribandhanamokṣaṇam /
pauṣṭikaṃ lipilekhādi kartavyaṃ karkaṭodaye //
1.56.d:
वापीकूपतडागादि वारिबन्धनमोक्षणम् ।
पौष्टिकं लिपिलेखादि कर्तव्यं कर्कटोदये ॥
1.56.m: Stepwells, wells, ponds, damming and releasing of water, / rites for nourishment, and writing of scripts should be performed at the rising of Cancer.

1.56.s:
ikṣudhānyavaṇikpaṇyakṛṣisevādayaḥsthire /
sāhasāhavabhūpādyaṃ siṃhalagne prasiddhyati //
1.56.d:
इक्षुधान्यवणिक्पण्यकृषिसेवादयःस्थिरे ।
साहसाहवभूपाद्यं सिंहलग्ने प्रसिद्ध्यति ॥
1.56.m: Sugarcane, grain, mercantile merchandise, agriculture, service, and fixed matters, / ventures of daring, battle, and kingly matters succeed in the Leo ascendant.

1.56.s:
vidyāśilpauṣadhaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca carasthiram /
kanyā lagne vidheyaṃ ca pauṣṭikākhilamaṅgalam //
1.56.d:
विद्याशिल्पौषधं कृत्यं भूषणं च चरस्थिरम् ।
कन्या लग्ने विधेयं च पौष्टिकाखिलमङ्गलम् ॥
1.56.m: Learning, crafts, medicine, actions, movable and fixed ornaments, / and all auspicious rites for nourishment should be performed in the Virgo ascendant.

1.56.s:
kṛṣivāṇijyayānaṃ ca paśūdvāhavratādikam /
tulāyāmakhilaṃ karma tulābhārāśrite ca yat //
1.56.d:
कृषिवाणिज्ययानं च पशूद्वाहव्रतादिकम् ।
तुलायामखिलं कर्म तुलाभाराश्रिते च यत् ॥
1.56.m: Agriculture, trade, journey, cattle, wedding, vows, / and every action pertaining to balances should be performed in Libra.

1.56.s:
sthirakarmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ rājasevābhiṣecanam /
cauryakarmasthirāraṃbhāḥ kartavyā vṛścikodaye //
1.56.d:
स्थिरकर्माखिलं कार्यं राजसेवाभिषेचनम् ।
चौर्यकर्मस्थिरारंभाः कर्तव्या वृश्चिकोदये ॥
1.56.m: All fixed actions should be done, service to kings, consecration, / theft, and firm undertakings should be performed at the rising of Scorpio.

1.56.s:
vratodvāhaprayāṇāśvagajaśilpakalādikam /
carasthiravimiśraṃ ca kartavyaṃ kārmukodaye //
1.56.d:
व्रतोद्वाहप्रयाणाश्वगजशिल्पकलादिकम् ।
चरस्थिरविमिश्रं च कर्तव्यं कार्मुकोदये ॥
1.56.m: Vows, wedding, journey, horses, elephants, crafts, and arts, / whether movable, fixed, or mixed, should be performed at the rising of Sagittarius.

1.56.s:
cāpabandhanamokṣāstrakṛṣigośvādikam yat /
prasthānaṃ paśudāsādi kartavyaṃ makarodaye //
1.56.d:
चापबन्धनमोक्षास्त्रकृषिगोश्वादिकम् यत् ।
प्रस्थानं पशुदासादि कर्तव्यं मकरोदये ॥
1.56.m: Stringing of bows, discharging of weapons, agriculture, cattle, horses, / departure, livestock, and servants should be dealt with at the rising of Capricorn.

1.56.s:
kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvaṃbuśilpaṅkarmakalādikam /
jalapātrāstrāśastrādi kartavyaṃ kalaśodaye //
1.56.d:
कृषिवाणिज्यपश्वंबुशिल्पङ्कर्मकलादिकम् ।
जलपात्रास्त्राशस्त्रादि कर्तव्यं कलशोदये ॥
1.56.m: Agriculture, trade, cattle, waterworks, crafts, and arts, / water-vessels, and weapons should be attended to at the rising of Aquarius.

1.56.s:
vratodvāhābhiṣekāṃbusthāpanaṃ sanniveśanam /
bhūṣaṇaṃ jalapātrāśvakarma mīnodaye śubham //
1.56.d:
व्रतोद्वाहाभिषेकांबुस्थापनं सन्निवेशनम् ।
भूषणं जलपात्राश्वकर्म मीनोदये शुभम् ॥
1.56.m: Vows, wedding, consecration, installation of water reservoirs, settlement, / ornaments, water-vessels, and acts concerning horses are auspicious at the rising of Pisces.

1.56.s:
meṣādiṣu kligneṣu śuddheṣvevaṃ prasiddhyati /
krūragrahekṣiteṣūgrasaṃyuteṣūgrameva hi //
1.56.d:
मेषादिषु क्लिग्नेषु शुद्धेष्वेवं प्रसिद्ध्यति ।
क्रूरग्रहेक्षितेषूग्रसंयुतेषूग्रमेव हि ॥
1.56.m: In ascendants beginning with Aries, thus success comes when they are pure; / but when aspected by malefic planets or conjoined with fierce ones, the result is indeed fierce.

1.56.s:
goyugmakarkakanyāntyatulācāpadharāḥ śubhāḥ /
śubharkṣatvāśubhāsatya itarā pāparāśayaḥ //
1.56.d:
गोयुग्मकर्ककन्यान्त्यतुलाचापधराः शुभाः ।
शुभर्क्षत्वाशुभासत्य इतरा पापराशयः ॥
1.56.m: Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Virgo, Pisces, Libra, and Sagittarius are auspicious; / because they are auspicious signs, the others are indeed malefic signs.

1.56.s:
grahayogāvalokābhyāṃ rāśirdhatte grahodbhavam /
phalaṃ tābhyāṃ vihīno 'sau svabhāvamupasarpati //
1.56.d:
ग्रहयोगावलोकाभ्यां राशिर्धत्ते ग्रहोद्भवम् ।
फलं ताभ्यां विहीनो ऽसौ स्वभावमुपसर्पति ॥
1.56.m: By planetary conjunction and aspect, a sign takes on the nature arising from that planet; / devoid of these two, it maintains its own inherent nature.

1.56.s:
ādau saṃpūrṇaphaladaṃ madhye madhyaphalapradam /
ante tucchaphale lagne sarvasminnevameva hi //
1.56.d:
आदौ संपूर्णफलदं मध्ये मध्यफलप्रदम् ।
अन्ते तुच्छफले लग्ने सर्वस्मिन्नेवमेव हि ॥
1.56.m: It yields full fruit at the beginning, middling fruit in the middle, / and negligible fruit at the end; this is indeed so in every ascendant.

1.56.s:
sarvatra prathamaṃ lagnaṃ kartuścandrabalaṃ tataḥ /
kalpyāmadindau balini saptame balino grahāḥ //
1.56.d:
सर्वत्र प्रथमं लग्नं कर्तुश्चन्द्रबलं ततः ।
कल्प्यामदिन्दौ बलिनि सप्तमे बलिनो ग्रहाः ॥
1.56.m: In all matters, the ascendant is foremost, and then the lunar strength of the performer; / when the Moon is strong, the planets in the seventh house are also judged strong.

1.56.s:
candrasya valimādhāramādheya cānyakheṭakam /
ādhārabhūtenādheyaṃ dhīyate paridhiṣṭinam //
1.56.d:
चन्द्रस्य वलिमाधारमाधेय चान्यखेटकम् ।
आधारभूतेनाधेयं धीयते परिधिष्टिनम् ॥
1.56.m: The strength of the Moon is the substratum, and the other planets are the content; / by means of the substratum, the content placed in that abode is sustained.

1.56.s:
cendinduḥ śubhadaḥ sarve grahāḥ śubhaphalapradāḥ /
aśubhaścedaśubhadā varjayitvā dhanādhipam //
1.56.d:
चेन्दिन्दुः शुभदः सर्वे ग्रहाः शुभफलप्रदाः ।
अशुभश्चेदशुभदा वर्जयित्वा धनाधिपम् ॥
1.56.m: If the Moon is auspicious, all planets yield auspicious results; / if it is inauspicious, they yield inauspicious results, except for the lord of wealth.

1.56.s:
lagnasyābhyuditā yeṃśāsteṣvaṃśeṣu sthito grahaḥ /
lagnodbhavaṃ phalaṃ dhatte dhanātīto dvitīyakam //
1.56.d:
लग्नस्याभ्युदिता येंशास्तेष्वंशेषु स्थितो ग्रहः ।
लग्नोद्भवं फलं धत्ते धनातीतो द्वितीयकम् ॥
1.56.m: A planet situated in the degrees of the ascendant that have already risen / brings forth the fruit arising from the ascendant; beyond the degrees of the ascendant, it brings forth that of the second house.

1.56.s:
evaṃ sthāneṣu śeṣeṣu caivamevaṃ prakalpayet /
lagnaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ labhyate 'lpairdinairno //
1.56.d:
एवं स्थानेषु शेषेषु चैवमेवं प्रकल्पयेत् ।
लग्नं सर्वगुणोपेतं लभ्यते ऽल्पैर्दिनैर्नो ॥
1.56.m: In the remaining houses too, one should reckon in the very same way. / An ascendant endowed with all good qualities is not easily obtained within a few days.

1.56.s:
doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikyaṃ bahu saṃtatamiṣyate /
doṣādduṣṭo hi kālastamapi mārṣṭuṃ pitāmahaḥ //
1.56.d:
दोषाल्पत्वं गुणाधिक्यं बहु संततमिष्यते ।
दोषाद्दुष्टो हि कालस्तमपि मार्ष्टुं पितामहः ॥
1.56.m: Few faults and an abundance of virtues are always desired; / for when a time is corrupted by faults, even Brahmā cannot wipe them away.

1.56.s:
apyaśaucatuṇādhikyaṃ doṣānyatte tato hi te /
amāriktāṣṭamīṣaṣṭīdvādaśīpratipatsvapi //
1.56.d:
अप्यशौचतुणाधिक्यं दोषान्यत्ते ततो हि ते ।
अमारिक्ताष्टमीषष्टीद्वादशीप्रतिपत्स्वपि ॥
1.56.m: Even ritual impurity and an abundance of straw cause other faults for you; / therefore, on the new moon, empty lunar days, the eighth, sixth, twelfth, and first lunar days,

1.56.s:
parighasya ca pūrvārddhaṃ vyatīpāte savaidhṛtau /
saṃdhyāsūpaplave viṣṭyāmaśubhaṃ prathamārttavam //
1.56.d:
परिघस्य च पूर्वार्द्धं व्यतीपाते सवैधृतौ ।
संध्यासूपप्लवे विष्ट्यामशुभं प्रथमार्त्तवम् ॥
1.56.m: and in the first half of Parigha, in Vyatīpāta and Vaidhṛti, / at twilight, during eclipses, and in Viṣṭi, the first menstruation is inauspicious.

1.56.s:
rugṇā patipriyā duḥkhī putriṇī bhogamī tathā /
pativratā keśayuktā sūryavārādiṣu kramāt //
1.56.d:
रुग्णा पतिप्रिया दुःखी पुत्रिणी भोगमी तथा ।
पतिव्रता केशयुक्ता सूर्यवारादिषु क्रमात् ॥
1.56.m: [On such days, a woman becomes] diseased, beloved of her husband, sorrowful, having sons, sensual, / devoted to her husband, or filled with trouble, respectively, on Sunday and following weekdays.

1.56.s:
yāmāgniraudrabhāgyayāhidvīśendrādihyupadviṣāḥ /
tārakā na hitā māsā madhūrjaśucipauṣakāḥ //
1.56.d:
यामाग्निरौद्रभाग्ययाहिद्वीशेन्द्रादिह्युपद्विषाः ।
तारका न हिता मासा मधूर्जशुचिपौषकाः ॥
1.56.m: The asterisms Bharaṇī, Kṛttikā, Ārdrā, Pūrvaphalgunī, Āśleṣā, Viśākhā, Jyeṣṭhā, etc., are harmful; / the months Caitra, Kārttika, Āṣāḍha, and Pauṣa are not beneficial.

1.56.s:
bhadrā ca saṃkramonidrā rātriścandrārkayorgrahaḥ /
kulaṭā pāpabhogeṣu nindyarkṣe nindyavāsare //
1.56.d:
भद्रा च संक्रमोनिद्रा रात्रिश्चन्द्रार्कयोर्ग्रहः ।
कुलटा पापभोगेषु निन्द्यर्क्षे निन्द्यवासरे ॥
1.56.m: Bhadrā, solar transit, sleep, night, and eclipses of the Moon or Sun— / on inauspicious asterisms and inauspicious weekdays, [she becomes] unchaste, indulging in sins.

1.56.s:
tilājyadūrvā juhuyādgāyatryāṣṭaśataṃ budhaḥ /
suvarṇagotilāndadyātsarvadoṣāpanuttaye //
1.56.d:
तिलाज्यदूर्वा जुहुयाद्गायत्र्याष्टशतं बुधः ।
सुवर्णगोतिलान्दद्यात्सर्वदोषापनुत्तये ॥
1.56.m: A wise man should offer one hundred and eight oblations of sesame seeds, clarified butter, and dūrvā grass with the gāyatrī, / and should give gold, a cow, and sesame seeds to remove all afflictions.

1.56.s:
ādyā niśaścatasrastu tyājyā hyapi samāḥ paraiḥ /
ojarāśyaṃśage candre lagne puṅgrahavīkṣite //
1.56.d:
आद्या निशश्चतस्रस्तु त्याज्या ह्यपि समाः परैः ।
ओजराश्यंशगे चन्द्रे लग्ने पुङ्ग्रहवीक्षिते ॥
1.56.m: The first four nights are to be avoided, and even nights are preferred by others; / when the Moon is in an odd sign or navāṃśa, and the ascendant is aspected by male planets,

1.56.s:
upavītī yugmatithāvanagnaḥ kāmayetstriyam /
putrārthī puruṣaśastyaktvā pauṣṇamūlāhipitryabham //
1.56.d:
उपवीती युग्मतिथावनग्नः कामयेत्स्त्रियम् ।
पुत्रार्थी पुरुषशस्त्यक्त्वा पौष्णमूलाहिपित्र्यभम् ॥
1.56.m: a man wearing the sacred thread, not naked, on an even lunar day, desiring a son, / should make love to his wife, avoiding the asterisms Revatī, Mūla, Āśleṣā, and Maghā.

1.56.s:
prasiddhe prathame garbhe tṛtīye vā dvitīyake /
māse puṃsavanaṃ kāryaṃ sīmantaṃ ca yathā tathā //
1.56.d:
प्रसिद्धे प्रथमे गर्भे तृतीये वा द्वितीयके ।
मासे पुंसवनं कार्यं सीमन्तं च यथा तथा ॥
1.56.m: When the first pregnancy is known, in the second or third / month, the puṃsavana rite should be performed, and the sīmanta in due manner.

1.56.s:
caturthe māsi ṣaṣṭe vāpyaṣṭame vā tadīśvare /
balopapanne daṃpatyoścandratārābalānvite //
1.56.d:
चतुर्थे मासि षष्टे वाप्यष्टमे वा तदीश्वरे ।
बलोपपन्ने दंपत्योश्चन्द्रताराबलान्विते ॥
1.56.m: In the fourth, sixth, or eighth month, when its ruling lord / is endowed with strength, and the couple possesses the strength of the Moon and asterisms,

1.56.s:
ariktāparvadivase kujajīvārkavāsare /
tīkṣṇamiśrārkavarjyeṣu puṃbhāṃśerātrināyake //
1.56.d:
अरिक्तापर्वदिवसे कुजजीवार्कवासरे ।
तीक्ष्णमिश्रार्कवर्ज्येषु पुंभांशेरात्रिनायके ॥
1.56.m: on a day that is not empty or a parvan, on Tuesday, Thursday, or Sunday, / avoiding sharp, mixed, and Sun asterisms, when the Moon is in a masculine sign or division,

1.56.s:
śuddhe 'ṣṭame janmalagnāttayorlagne na naidhane /
śubhagrahayute dṛṣṭe pāpadṛṣṭivivarjite //
1.56.d:
शुद्धे ऽष्टमे जन्मलग्नात्तयोर्लग्ने न नैधने ।
शुभग्रहयुते दृष्टे पापदृष्टिविवर्जिते ॥
1.56.m: when the eighth house from their birth ascendant is pure, the ascendant not being the eighth, / conjoined with or aspected by auspicious planets, and devoid of the aspect of malefic planets,

1.56.s:
śubhagraheṣu dhīdharmakendreṣvaribhave triṣu /
pāpeṣu satsu candretyanidhanādyarivarjite //
1.56.d:
शुभग्रहेषु धीधर्मकेन्द्रेष्वरिभवे त्रिषु ।
पापेषु सत्सु चन्द्रेत्यनिधनाद्यरिवर्जिते ॥
1.56.m: when auspicious planets are in the fifth, ninth, and kendra houses, and malefic planets / are in the sixth, eleventh, and third houses, and the Moon is devoid of the eighth, first, and sixth houses.

1.56.s:
krūragrahāṇāmekopi lagnādantyātmajāṣṭagaḥ /
sīmantinīṃ vā tadgarbhaṃ balī hṝnti na saṃśayaḥ //
1.56.d:
क्रूरग्रहाणामेकोपि लग्नादन्त्यात्मजाष्टगः ।
सीमन्तिनीं वा तद्गर्भं बली हॄन्ति न संशयः ॥
1.56.m: Even a single cruel planet situated in the twelfth, fifth, or eighth house from the ascendant, / if strong, undoubtedly kills the woman or her fetus.

1.56.s:
tasmiñjanmamuhūrte 'pi sūtakāntepi vā śiśoḥ /
jātakarma prakartavyaṃ pitṛpūjanapūrvakam //
1.56.d:
तस्मिञ्जन्ममुहूर्ते ऽपि सूतकान्तेपि वा शिशोः ।
जातकर्म प्रकर्तव्यं पितृपूजनपूर्वकम् ॥
1.56.m: At that very birth-moment, or at the end of the period of birth-impurity, / the birth-rite of the child should be performed, preceded by the worship of the ancestors.

1.56.s:
sūtakānte nāmakarma vidheyaṃ tatkulocitam /
nāmapūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syānmaṅgalaiḥ susamīkṣitaiḥ //
1.56.d:
सूतकान्ते नामकर्म विधेयं तत्कुलोचितम् ।
नामपूर्वं प्रशस्तं स्यान्मङ्गलैः सुसमीक्षितैः ॥
1.56.m: At the end of the period of birth-impurity, the naming ceremony suited to one's family should be performed. / The prefix of the name should be auspicious, accompanied by well-examined auspicious signs.

1.56.s:
deśakālopaghātādyaiḥ kālātikramaṇaṃ yadā /
anastage bhṛgāvījye tatkārye cottarāyaṇe //
1.56.d:
देशकालोपघाताद्यैः कालातिक्रमणं यदा ।
अनस्तगे भृगावीज्ये तत्कार्ये चोत्तरायणे ॥
1.56.m: When there is a lapse of time due to afflictions of place, time, and so forth, / it should be performed during the northern course of the sun, when Venus and Jupiter are uncombust,

1.56.s:
carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhavāsare /
candrātārābalopete divase ca śiśoḥ pituḥ //
1.56.d:
चरस्थिरमृदुक्षिप्रनक्षत्रे शुभवासरे ।
चन्द्राताराबलोपेते दिवसे च शिशोः पितुः ॥
1.56.m: in a movable, fixed, gentle, or swift lunar mansion, on an auspicious weekday, / on a day possessing the strength of the moon and stars for the child and the father,

1.56.s:
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca nidhane śuddhisaṃyute /
ṣaṣṭe māsyaṣṭame vāpi puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ tu pañcame //
1.56.d:
शुभलग्ने शुभांशे च निधने शुद्धिसंयुते ।
षष्टे मास्यष्टमे वापि पुंसां स्त्रीणां तु पञ्चमे ॥
1.56.m: under an auspicious ascendant and auspicious navāṃśa, with purity in the eighth house, / in the sixth or eighth month for males, but in the fifth for females.

1.56.s:
saptame māsi vā kāryaṃ navānnapraśanaṃ śubham /
riktāṃ dinakṣayaṃ nandāṃ dvādaśīmaṣṭamīmatha //
1.56.d:
सप्तमे मासि वा कार्यं नवान्नप्रशनं शुभम् ।
रिक्तां दिनक्षयं नन्दां द्वादशीमष्टमीमथ ॥
1.56.m: Or in the seventh month, the auspicious first feeding of new grain is to be performed. / Having avoided a riktā, a day of loss (dinakṣaya), a nandā, the twelfth, and also the eighth [lunar day],

1.56.s:
tyaktvānyatithiṣu proktaṃ praśanaṃ śubhavāsare /
carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhanaidhane //
1.56.d:
त्यक्त्वान्यतिथिषु प्रोक्तं प्रशनं शुभवासरे ।
चरस्थिरमृदुक्षिप्रनक्षत्रे शुभनैधने ॥
1.56.m: Feeding is prescribed on the other lunar days, on an auspicious weekday, / under a movable, fixed, gentle, or swift asterism, when the eighth house is auspicious,

1.56.s:
daśame śuddhisaṃyukte śubhalagne śubhāṃśake /
pūrvārddhe saumyakheṭena saṃyukte vīkṣitepi vā //
1.56.d:
दशमे शुद्धिसंयुक्ते शुभलग्ने शुभांशके ।
पूर्वार्द्धे सौम्यखेटेन संयुक्ते वीक्षितेपि वा ॥
1.56.m: When the tenth house is pure, in an auspicious ascendant and auspicious navāṃśa, / in the first half [of the day], combined with or aspected by a benefic planet,

1.56.s:
triṣaṣṭalābhagaiḥ krūraiḥ kendradhīdharmagaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
vyayārinidhanasthe ca candre 'nnaprāśanaṃ śubham //
1.56.d:
त्रिषष्टलाभगैः क्रूरैः केन्द्रधीधर्मगैः शुभैः ।
व्ययारिनिधनस्थे च चन्द्रे ऽन्नप्राशनं शुभम् ॥
1.56.m: With malefics in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, with benefics in quadrants, the fifth, or ninth houses, / and the Moon in the twelfth, sixth, or eighth house, the first feeding of grain is auspicious.

1.56.s:
tṛtīye pañcame cābde svakulācārato 'pi vā /
bālānāṃ janmataścaulaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ //
1.56.d:
तृतीये पञ्चमे चाब्दे स्वकुलाचारतो ऽपि वा ।
बालानां जन्मतश्चौलं स्वगृह्योक्तविधानतः ॥
1.56.m: In the third or fifth year, or according to one’s own family custom, / the tonsure of boys from birth is to be done according to the rule prescribed in one’s own Gṛhyasūtra,

1.56.s:
saumyāyane nāstagayoḥ surārisuramantriṇoḥ /
aparvariktātithiṣu śukrejyajñenduvāsare //
1.56.d:
सौम्यायने नास्तगयोः सुरारिसुरमन्त्रिणोः ।
अपर्वरिक्तातिथिषु शुक्रेज्यज्ञेन्दुवासरे ॥
1.56.m: During the northern course of the sun, when the counsellor of the enemies of the gods (Śukra) and the counsellor of the gods (Bṛhaspati) have not set, / on non-parvan and non-riktā lunar days, on Friday, Thursday, Wednesday, or Monday,

1.56.s:
dasrāditījyacandrendrapūṣabhāni śubhāni ca /
caulakarmaṇi hastakṣārrtrīṇitrīṇi ca viṣṇubhāt //
1.56.d:
दस्रादितीज्यचन्द्रेन्द्रपूषभानि शुभानि च ।
चौलकर्मणि हस्तक्षार्र्त्रीणित्रीणि च विष्णुभात् ॥
1.56.m: Aśvinī, Punarvasu, Puṣya, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Jyeṣṭhā, and Revatī are auspicious; / in the rite of tonsure, the three asterisms from Hasta and the three from Śravaṇa [are auspicious].

1.56.s:
paṭṭabandhanacaulānnaprāśane copanāyane /
śubhadaṃ janmanakṣatramaśubhaṃ tvanyakarmaṇi //
1.56.d:
पट्टबन्धनचौलान्नप्राशने चोपनायने ।
शुभदं जन्मनक्षत्रमशुभं त्वन्यकर्मणि ॥
1.56.m: In the tying of the fillet, tonsure, the first feeding of grain, and the sacred-thread investiture, / the birth asterism yields good fortune, but in other rites it is inauspicious.

1.56.s:
aṣṭame śuddhisaṃyukteṃ śubhalagne śubhāṃśake /
janmāṣṭame na śītāṃśau ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite //
1.56.d:
अष्टमे शुद्धिसंयुक्तें शुभलग्ने शुभांशके ।
जन्माष्टमे न शीतांशौ षष्टाष्टान्त्यविवर्जिते ॥
1.56.m: When the eighth house is pure, in an auspicious ascendant and auspicious navāṃśa, / with the cold-rayed Moon not in the eighth house from the birth-Moon, avoiding the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses,

1.56.s:
dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ /
abhyakte sandhyayornāre niśi bhuktvā na vāhave //
1.56.d:
धनत्रिकोणकेन्द्रस्थैः शुभैस्त्र्यायारिगैः परैः ।
अभ्यक्ते सन्ध्ययोर्नारे निशि भुक्त्वा न वाहवे ॥
1.56.m: With benefics occupying the second, trine, and quadrant houses, and others occupying the third, eleventh, and sixth houses. / Shaving is not to be done when smeared with oil, at the two twilights, on Tuesday, at night, having eaten, nor in battle,

1.56.s:
notkaṭe bhūṣite naiva yāne na navame 'hni ca /
kṣaurakarma mahīpānāṃ pañcamepañcame 'hani //
1.56.d:
नोत्कटे भूषिते नैव याने न नवमे ऽह्नि च ।
क्षौरकर्म महीपानां पञ्चमेपञ्चमे ऽहनि ॥
1.56.m: Nor when arrogant, nor when adorned, nor in a vehicle, nor on the ninth lunar day. / The shaving of kings is to be done on every fifth day;

1.56.s:
kartavyaṃ kṣoranakṣatre 'pyatha vāsyodaye śubham /
nṛpaviprājñayā yajñe maraṇe bandhamokṣaṇeṃ //
1.56.d:
कर्तव्यं क्षोरनक्षत्रे ऽप्यथ वास्योदये शुभम् ।
नृपविप्राज्ञया यज्ञे मरणे बन्धमोक्षणें ॥
1.56.m: It is to be done under a shaving asterism, or auspiciously at its rising; / or by the command of a king or a brāhmaṇa, at a sacrifice, upon a death, or upon release from bondage.

1.56.s:
udvāhe 'khilavārarkṣatithiṣu kṣauramiṣṭadam /
kartavyaṃ maṅgaleṣvādau maṅgalāya kṣurārpaṇam //
1.56.d:
उद्वाहे ऽखिलवारर्क्षतिथिषु क्षौरमिष्टदम् ।
कर्तव्यं मङ्गलेष्वादौ मङ्गलाय क्षुरार्पणम् ॥
1.56.m: In marriage, shaving is wish-granting on all weekdays, asterisms, and lunar days. / In auspicious rites, the application of the razor is to be done first for the sake of good fortune.

1.56.s:
navame saptame vāpi pañcame divase 'pi vā /
tṛtīye bījanakṣatre śubhavāre śubhodaye //
1.56.d:
नवमे सप्तमे वापि पञ्चमे दिवसे ऽपि वा ।
तृतीये बीजनक्षत्रे शुभवारे शुभोदये ॥
1.56.m: On the ninth, seventh, fifth, / or third day, under a seed-sowing asterism, on an auspicious weekday, at an auspicious rising,

1.56.s:
samyaggṛhāṇyalaṅkṛtya vitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ /
āśiṣo vācanaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyāṅganādibhiḥ //
1.56.d:
सम्यग्गृहाण्यलङ्कृत्य वितानध्वजतोरणैः ।
आशिषो वाचनं कार्यं पुण्यं पुण्याङ्गनादिभिः ॥
1.56.m: Having properly decorated the houses with canopies, flags, and arched doorways, / a recitation of auspicious blessings should be performed by virtuous women and others.

1.56.s:
sahavāditranṛtyādyairgatvā prāguttarāṃ diśam /
tatra mṛdatatastīkṣṇā gṛhītvā punarāgataḥ //
1.56.d:
सहवादित्रनृत्याद्यैर्गत्वा प्रागुत्तरां दिशम् ।
तत्र मृदततस्तीक्ष्णा गृहीत्वा पुनरागतः ॥
1.56.m: Having gone toward the north-east with musical instruments, dance, and the like, / and having taken sharp, fresh earth from there, returning again,

1.56.s:
mṛṇyaye 'pyathavā vaiṇave 'pi pātre prapūrayet /
anekabījasaṃyuktaṃ toyaṃ puṣpābhiśobhitam //
1.56.d:
मृण्यये ऽप्यथवा वैणवे ऽपि पात्रे प्रपूरयेत् ।
अनेकबीजसंयुक्तं तोयं पुष्पाभिशोभितम् ॥
1.56.m: One should fill an earthen or bamboo vessel / with water containing many seeds and adorned with flowers.

1.56.s:
ādhānādaṣṭame varṣe janmato vāgrajanmanām /
rājñā mekādaśe maiñjībandhanaṃ dvādaśe viśām //
1.56.d:
आधानादष्टमे वर्षे जन्मतो वाग्रजन्मनाम् ।
राज्ञा मेकादशे मैञ्जीबन्धनं द्वादशे विशाम् ॥
1.56.m: The tying of the muñja grass girdle is in the eighth year from conception or from birth for the first-born (brāhmaṇas), / in the eleventh for kings (kṣatriyas), and in the twelfth for vaiśyas.

1.56.s:
janmataḥ pañcame varṣe vedaśāstrariṃśāradaḥ /
upavītī yataḥ śrīmānkāryaṃ tatropanāyanam //
1.56.d:
जन्मतः पञ्चमे वर्षे वेदशास्त्ररिंशारदः ।
उपवीती यतः श्रीमान्कार्यं तत्रोपनायनम् ॥
1.56.m: Or, from birth in the fifth year, in order that the boy become learned in the Vedas and Śāstras, / endowed with the sacred thread, and prosperous, the investiture should be performed then.

1.56.s:
bālasya balahīno 'pari sito jīvaḥ śubhapradaḥ /
yathoktavatsare kāryamanukte nopanāyanam //
1.56.d:
बालस्य बलहीनो ऽपरि सितो जीवः शुभप्रदः ।
यथोक्तवत्सरे कार्यमनुक्ते नोपनायनम् ॥
1.56.m: Even if devoid of strength for a child, Śukra and Bṛhaspati grant good fortune. / The investiture is to be performed in the year prescribed, not in an unprescribed one.

1.56.s:
dṛśyamānagurau śukre śākheśe cottarāyaṇe /
vedānāmadhipā jīvaśukrabhaumabudhāḥ kramāt //
1.56.d:
दृश्यमानगुरौ शुक्रे शाखेशे चोत्तरायणे ।
वेदानामधिपा जीवशुक्रभौमबुधाः क्रमात् ॥
1.56.m: When Bṛhaspati, Śukra, and the lord of the Vedic branch are visible, and in the northern course of the sun. / The lords of the Vedas are, respectively, Bṛhaspati, Śukra, Mars, and Mercury.

1.56.s:
śaradgrīṣmavasaṃteṣu vyutkramāttu dvijanmanām /
mukhyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ tapomāsādipañcasu //
1.56.d:
शरद्ग्रीष्मवसंतेषु व्युत्क्रमात्तु द्विजन्मनाम् ।
मुख्यं साधारणं तेषां तपोमासादिपञ्चसु ॥
1.56.m: In autumn, summer, and spring, respectively, in reverse order for the twice-born. / The primary, common time for them is in the five months beginning with the month of Tapas (Māgha).

1.56.s:
svakulācāradharmajño mādhamāse tu phalgune /
vidhijñaścārthavāṃścaitre vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
1.56.d:
स्वकुलाचारधर्मज्ञो माधमासे तु फल्गुने ।
विधिज्ञश्चार्थवांश्चैत्रे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ॥
1.56.m: [Invested] in the month of Māgha, he knows the family customs and duty; in Phālguna, / he knows the rules and is wealthy; in Caitra, he masters the Vedas and Vedāṅgas;

1.56.s:
vaiśāṣe dhanavānvendaśāstravidyāviśāradaḥ /
upanīto balāḍhyaśca jyeṣṭhe vidhividāṃ varaḥ //
1.56.d:
वैशाषे धनवान्वेन्दशास्त्रविद्याविशारदः ।
उपनीतो बलाढ्यश्च ज्येष्ठे विधिविदां वरः ॥
1.56.m: In Vaiśākha, he becomes wealthy and learned in the knowledge of the Vedas and Śāstras; / invested in Jyeṣṭha, he becomes full of strength and the best of knowers of ritual.

1.56.s:
śuklapakṣe dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā pañcamī tathā /
trayodaśī ca daśamī saptamī vratabandhane //
1.56.d:
शुक्लपक्षे द्वितीया च तृतीया पञ्चमी तथा ।
त्रयोदशी च दशमी सप्तमी व्रतबन्धने ॥
1.56.m: In the bright fortnight, the second, third, and fifth, / as well as the thirteenth, tenth, and seventh are good for the binding of the vow (investiture);

1.56.s:
śreṣṭhā tvekādaśī ṣaṣṭī dvādaśyanyāstu madhyamāḥ /
kṛthaṣṇe dvitrīṣusaṃkhyāśca tithyo 'nyā hyatininditāḥ //
1.56.d:
श्रेष्ठा त्वेकादशी षष्टी द्वादश्यन्यास्तु मध्यमाः ।
कृथष्णे द्वित्रीषुसंख्याश्च तिथ्यो ऽन्या ह्यतिनिन्दिताः ॥
1.56.m: The eleventh, sixth, and twelfth are best, while the others are middling. / In the dark fortnight, the lunar days numbered two, three, and five [are acceptable]; the others are highly condemned.

1.56.s:
dhiṣṇānyarkatrayāntejyarudrādityuttarāṇi ca /
viṣṇutrayāṃśvimitrābjayonibhānyupanāyane //
1.56.d:
धिष्णान्यर्कत्रयान्तेज्यरुद्रादित्युत्तराणि च ।
विष्णुत्रयांश्विमित्राब्जयोनिभान्युपनायने ॥
1.56.m: The asterisms are the three from Hasta, Puṣya, Ārdrā, the three Uttarās, / the three from Śravaṇa, Anurādhā, and Rohiṇī for the sacred-thread investiture.

1.56.s:
janmabhāddaśamaṃ karma saṃghātarkṣaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam /
aṣṭādaśaṃ samudayaṃ trayoviṃśaṃ vināśanam //
1.56.d:
जन्मभाद्दशमं कर्म संघातर्क्षं तु षोडशम् ।
अष्टादशं समुदयं त्रयोविंशं विनाशनम् ॥
1.56.m: The tenth asterism from the birth-star is the karma star, the sixteenth is the saṃghāta star, / the eighteenth is the samudaya, the twenty-third is the vināśana,

1.56.s:
mānasaṃ mānasaṃ pañcaviṃśarkṣaṃ nācarecchubhameṣu tu /
ācāryasaumyakāvyānāṃ vārāḥ śastāḥ śaśīnayoḥ //
1.56.d:
मानसं मानसं पञ्चविंशर्क्षं नाचरेच्छुभमेषु तु ।
आचार्यसौम्यकाव्यानां वाराः शस्ताः शशीनयोः ॥
1.56.m: And the twenty-fifth is the mānasa star; one should not perform an auspicious rite under these. / The days of Bṛhaspati, Mercury, and Śukra are praiseworthy; those of the Moon and the Sun

1.56.s:
vārau tu madhyamau caiva vrate 'nyau ninditau matau /
tridhā vibhajya divasaṃ tatrādau karma daivikam //
1.56.d:
वारौ तु मध्यमौ चैव व्रते ऽन्यौ निन्दितौ मतौ ।
त्रिधा विभज्य दिवसं तत्रादौ कर्म दैविकम् ॥
1.56.m: Are middling, and the other two are considered condemned for the vow. / Dividing the day into three parts: in the first, divine work;

1.56.s:
dvitīye mānuṣaṃ kāryaṃ tṛtīye ḥṃśe ca paitṛkam /
svanīcage tadaṃśe vā svāribhe vā tadaṃśake //
1.56.d:
द्वितीये मानुषं कार्यं तृतीये ःंशे च पैतृकम् ।
स्वनीचगे तदंशे वा स्वारिभे वा तदंशके ॥
1.56.m: In the second, human work should be done; and in the third part, ancestral work. / When the lord of the Vedic branch or Bṛhaspati and Ketu are in their debilitation sign or its navāṃśa, or in their enemy’s sign or its navāṃśa,

1.56.s:
guruśikhinośca śākheśe kalāśīlavivarjitaḥ /
svādhiśatrugṛhasthe vā tadaṃśasthe 'tha vā vratī //
1.56.d:
गुरुशिखिनोश्च शाखेशे कलाशीलविवर्जितः ।
स्वाधिशत्रुगृहस्थे वा तदंशस्थे ऽथ वा व्रती ॥
1.56.m: The initiate is bereft of arts and character; or if the lord of the Vedic branch is in the house of a bitter enemy, or in its navāṃśa,

1.56.s:
śākheśe vā gurau śukre mahāpātakakṛdbhavet /
svoccasaṃsthe tadaṃśe vā svarāśau rāśige gaṇe //
1.56.d:
शाखेशे वा गुरौ शुक्रे महापातककृद्भवेत् ।
स्वोच्चसंस्थे तदंशे वा स्वराशौ राशिगे गणे ॥
1.56.m: Or if Bṛhaspati or Śukra is such, he becomes a committer of great sins. / But when placed in its exaltation sign or its navāṃśa, or in its own sign or the group of signs [favourable],

1.56.s:
śākheśe vā gurau śukre kendrage vā trikoṇage /
atīva dhanavāṃścaiva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
1.56.d:
शाखेशे वा गुरौ शुक्रे केन्द्रगे वा त्रिकोणगे ।
अतीव धनवांश्चैव वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ॥
1.56.m: If the lord of the Vedic branch, or Bṛhaspati, or Śukra is in a quadrant or a trine, / he becomes exceedingly wealthy and a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

1.56.s:
paramoccagate jīve śākheśe vātha vā sate /
vratī viśuddhe nidhane vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ //
1.56.d:
परमोच्चगते जीवे शाखेशे वाथ वा सते ।
व्रती विशुद्धे निधने वेदशास्त्रविशारदः ॥
1.56.m: When Bṛhaspati, the lord of the Vedic branch, or Mercury is in deep exaltation, / the eighth house being completely pure, the initiate becomes learned in the Vedas and Śāstras.

1.56.s:
svādhimitragṛhasthe vā tasyoñcasthe tadaṃśage /
gurau bhṛgau vā śākheśe vidyādhanasamanvitaḥ //
1.56.d:
स्वाधिमित्रगृहस्थे वा तस्योञ्चस्थे तदंशगे ।
गुरौ भृगौ वा शाखेशे विद्याधनसमन्वितः ॥
1.56.m: Or if the lord of the Vedic branch, Bṛhaspati, or Śukra is in the house of an intimate friend, or in its exaltation, or its navāṃśa, / he is endowed with learning and wealth.

1.56.s:
śākhādhipativāraśca śākhādhipabalaṃ śiśoḥ /
śaākhādhipatilagnaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tritayaṃ vrate //
1.56.d:
शाखाधिपतिवारश्च शाखाधिपबलं शिशोः ।
शआखाधिपतिलग्नं च दुर्लभं त्रितयं व्रते ॥
1.56.m: The weekday of the lord of the Vedic branch, the strength of the lord of the Vedic branch for the child, / and the ascendant of the lord of the Vedic branch—this triad is difficult to obtain in the investiture.

1.56.s:
tasmādvedvāṃśage candre vratī vidyāviśāradaḥ /
pāpāṃśage vā daridro nityaduḥkhitaḥ //
1.56.d:
तस्माद्वेद्वांशगे चन्द्रे व्रती विद्याविशारदः ।
पापांशगे वा दरिद्रो नित्यदुःखितः ॥
1.56.m: Therefore, when the Moon is in an intelligent (or Vedic) navāṃśa, the initiate is skilled in learning; / but if [the Moon] is in a malefic navāṃśa, he becomes poor and constantly afflicted.

1.56.s:
śravaṇādini nakṣatre karkāṃśasthe niśākare /
tadā vratī vedaśāstradhanadhānyasamṛddhimān //
1.56.d:
श्रवणादिनि नक्षत्रे कर्कांशस्थे निशाकरे ।
तदा व्रती वेदशास्त्रधनधान्यसमृद्धिमान् ॥
1.56.m: When the Moon is in asterisms beginning with Śravaṇa and situated in a Cancer navāṃśa, / then the initiate abounds in [knowledge of] the Vedas and Śāstras, wealth, and grains.

1.56.s:
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca naidhane śuddhisaṃyute /
lagne tu nidhane saumyaiḥ saṃyute vā nirīkṣite //
1.56.d:
शुभलग्ने शुभांशे च नैधने शुद्धिसंयुते ।
लग्ने तु निधने सौम्यैः संयुते वा निरीक्षिते ॥
1.56.m: In an auspicious ascendant and an auspicious navāṃśa, with the eighth house pure, / the ascendant or the eighth house combined with or aspected by benefics,

1.56.s:
iṣṭairjīvārkacandrādyaiḥ pañcabhirbalibhirgrahai /
sthānādibalasaṃpūrṇaiścaturbhirvā śubhānvitaiḥ //
1.56.d:
इष्टैर्जीवार्कचन्द्राद्यैः पञ्चभिर्बलिभिर्ग्रहै ।
स्थानादिबलसंपूर्णैश्चतुर्भिर्वा शुभान्वितैः ॥
1.56.m: Aspected by five strong, favourable planets such as Bṛhaspati, the Sun, the Moon, and others, / or by four endowed with positional and other strengths and combined with benefics,

1.56.s:
īkṣannaivātraikaviṃśamahādoṣavivarjite /
rāśayaḥ sakalāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhagrahayutekṣitāḥ //
1.56.d:
ईक्षन्नैवात्रैकविंशमहादोषविवर्जिते ।
राशयः सकलाः श्रेष्ठाः शुभग्रहयुतेक्षिताः ॥
1.56.m: Free from the twenty-one great blemishes—all zodiac signs are excellent when conjoined with or aspected by benefic planets;

1.56.s:
śubhanavāṃśakagatā grāhyāste śubharāśayaḥ /
na kadācitkarkaṭāṃśaśubhekṣitayuto 'pi vā //
1.56.d:
शुभनवांशकगता ग्राह्यास्ते शुभराशयः ।
न कदाचित्कर्कटांशशुभेक्षितयुतो ऽपि वा ॥
1.56.m: Those auspicious signs situated in an auspicious navāṃśa should be chosen, / never a Cancer navāṃśa, even if aspected by or conjoined with a benefic.

1.56.s:
tasmādgomithunāṃśāśca tulākanyāṃśakāḥ śubhāḥ /
evaṃvidhe lagnagate navāṃśe vratamīritam //
1.56.d:
तस्माद्गोमिथुनांशाश्च तुलाकन्यांशकाः शुभाः ।
एवंविधे लग्नगते नवांशे व्रतमीरितम् ॥
1.56.m: Therefore, Taurus and Gemini navāṃśas, as well as Libra and Virgo navāṃśas, are auspicious. / The investiture is declared [to be performed] when such a navāṃśa has risen in the ascendant,

1.56.s:
triṣaḍāyagataiḥ pāpaiḥ ṣaḍaṣṭāntyavivarjitaiḥ /
śubhaiḥ ṣaṣṭāṣṭalagnāntyavarjitena himāṃśunā //
1.56.d:
त्रिषडायगतैः पापैः षडष्टान्त्यविवर्जितैः ।
शुभैः षष्टाष्टलग्नान्त्यवर्जितेन हिमांशुना ॥
1.56.m: With malefics in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, with benefics avoiding the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses, / and with the Moon avoiding the sixth, eighth, ascendant, and twelfth houses.

1.56.s:
svoñcasaṃstho 'pi śītāṃśurvratino yadi lagnagaḥ /
na karoti śiśuṃ niḥsvaṃ sarvataḥ kṣayarogiṇam //
1.56.d:
स्वोञ्चसंस्थो ऽपि शीतांशुर्व्रतिनो यदि लग्नगः ।
न करोति शिशुं निःस्वं सर्वतः क्षयरोगिणम् ॥
1.56.m: Even if placed in its exaltation, if the cold-rayed Moon is in the ascendant of the initiate, / does it not make the child destitute and afflicted with consumption in every way?

1.56.s:
sphūrjite kendrage bhānau vratināṃ pitṛnāśanam /
pañcadoṣonitaṃ lagnaṃ śubhadaṃ copanāyane //
1.56.d:
स्फूर्जिते केन्द्रगे भानौ व्रतिनां पितृनाशनम् ।
पञ्चदोषोनितं लग्नं शुभदं चोपनायने ॥
1.56.m: When the blazing Sun is in a quadrant, it causes the destruction of the initiates’ fathers. / An ascendant devoid of the five blemishes bestows good fortune in the sacred-thread investiture.

1.56.s:
vinā vasaṃtaṛtunā kṛṣṇapakṣe galagrahe /
anadhyāye viṣṭiṣaṣṭyorna tu saskāramarhati //
1.56.d:
विना वसंतऋतुना कृष्णपक्षे गलग्रहे ।
अनध्याये विष्टिषष्ट्योर्न तु सस्कारमर्हति ॥
1.56.m: Except in the spring season, during a galagraha day in the dark fortnight, / on an unpromulgated study day (anadhyāya), on a viṣṭi karaṇa, or on a sixth lunar day, he does not deserve the sacrament.

1.56.s:
trayodaśyādicatvāri saptamyādidinatrayam /
caturthī vā śubhāḥ proktā aṣṭāvete galagrahāḥ //
1.56.d:
त्रयोदश्यादिचत्वारि सप्तम्यादिदिनत्रयम् ।
चतुर्थी वा शुभाः प्रोक्ता अष्टावेते गलग्रहाः ॥
1.56.m: The four days beginning with the thirteenth, the three days beginning with the seventh, / or the fourth tithi are declared auspicious; these eight are the throat-planets.

1.56.s:
kṣurikābandhaṃ vakṣye nṛpāṇāṃ prākkaragrahāt /
vivāhokteṣu māseṣu śuklapakṣe 'pyanastage //
1.56.d:
क्षुरिकाबन्धं वक्ष्ये नृपाणां प्राक्करग्रहात् ।
विवाहोक्तेषु मासेषु शुक्लपक्षे ऽप्यनस्तगे ॥
1.56.m: I shall explain the girding of the knife for kings prior to taking the hand [in marriage]: / in the months prescribed for marriage, during the bright fortnight, and when they are not combust,

1.56.s:
jīve śukre ca bhūputre candratārābalānvite /
maiñjībandhoktatithiṣu kujavarjitavāsare //
1.56.d:
जीवे शुक्रे च भूपुत्रे चन्द्रताराबलान्विते ।
मैञ्जीबन्धोक्ततिथिषु कुजवर्जितवासरे ॥
1.56.m: when Jupiter, Venus, and Mars are endowed with the strength of the moon and stars, / on the tithis prescribed for the girdle-tying, on a weekday excluding Tuesday,

1.56.s:
nacennavāṃśake karturaṣṭamodayavarjite /
śuddhe 'ṣṭame vidhau lagne ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite //
1.56.d:
नचेन्नवांशके कर्तुरष्टमोदयवर्जिते ।
शुद्धे ऽष्टमे विधौ लग्ने षष्टाष्टान्त्यविवर्जिते ॥
1.56.m: not in a navāṃśa that is the eighth from the agent's rising sign, / when the eighth house is pure, the Moon is in the ascendant, and the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses are free [of malefics].

1.56.s:
dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ /
kṣurikābandhanaṃ kāryamarcayitvāmarānpitṝn //
1.56.d:
धनत्रिकोणकेन्द्रस्थैः शुभैस्त्र्यायारिगैः परैः ।
क्षुरिकाबन्धनं कार्यमर्चयित्वामरान्पितॄन् ॥
1.56.m: With benefics situated in the second, trine, and quadrant houses, and the others in the third, eleventh, and sixth, / having worshipped the gods and the ancestors, the girding of the knife should be performed.

1.56.s:
arcayetkṣurikāṃ samyagdevatānāṃ ca sannidhau /
tataḥ sulagne badhnīyātkaṭyāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutām //
1.56.d:
अर्चयेत्क्षुरिकां सम्यग्देवतानां च सन्निधौ ।
ततः सुलग्ने बध्नीयात्कट्यां लक्षणसंयुताम् ॥
1.56.m: One should properly worship the knife in the presence of the deities; / then, under an auspicious ascendant, one should bind it, endowed with auspicious marks, upon the waist.

1.56.s:
āyāmārddhāgravistārapramāṇenaivacchedayat /
tacchedakhaṇḍānyāyāḥ syurdhvajāye ripunāśanam //
1.56.d:
आयामार्द्धाग्रविस्तारप्रमाणेनैवच्छेदयत् ।
तच्छेदखण्डान्यायाः स्युर्ध्वजाये रिपुनाशनम् ॥
1.56.m: One should measure the cut by half the length and the width of the tip; / the sections of that cut yield the āyas: in the flag-āya there is destruction of enemies,

1.56.s:
ghūmrāye maraṇaṃ siṃhe jayaḥ śuni ca rogitā /
dhanalābho vṛṣe 'tyantaṃ duḥkhī bhavati gardabhe //
1.56.d:
घूम्राये मरणं सिंहे जयः शुनि च रोगिता ।
धनलाभो वृषे ऽत्यन्तं दुःखी भवति गर्दभे ॥
1.56.m: in the smoke-āya death, in the lion victory, and in the dog disease; / in the bull there is great gain of wealth, in the donkey one becomes miserable,

1.56.s:
gajāye 'tyantasaṃprītirdhvāṅkṣe vittavināśanam /
khaḍgaputrikayormānaṃ gaṇayetsvāṅgulena tu //
1.56.d:
गजाये ऽत्यन्तसंप्रीतिर्ध्वाङ्क्षे वित्तविनाशनम् ।
खड्गपुत्रिकयोर्मानं गणयेत्स्वाङ्गुलेन तु ॥
1.56.m: in the elephant-āya there is extreme joy, and in the crow loss of wealth. / One should calculate the measure of the sword and dagger by one's own digits.

1.56.s:
mānāṅguleṣu paryāyāmekādaśamitāṃ tyajet /
śeṣāṇāmagulīnāṃ ca phalāni syuryathākramam //
1.56.d:
मानाङ्गुलेषु पर्यायामेकादशमितां त्यजेत् ।
शेषाणामगुलीनां च फलानि स्युर्यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.56.m: Among the measured digits, one should discard the cycles of eleven; / and of the remaining digits, the results are respectively:

1.56.s:
putralābhaḥ śatruvadhaḥ strīlābho gamana śubham /
arthahāniścārthavṛddhiḥ prīti siddhijayaḥ stutiḥ //
1.56.d:
पुत्रलाभः शत्रुवधः स्त्रीलाभो गमन शुभम् ।
अर्थहानिश्चार्थवृद्धिः प्रीति सिद्धिजयः स्तुतिः ॥
1.56.m: obtaining a son, slaying of enemies, obtaining a woman, auspicious travel, / loss of wealth, increase of wealth, affection, success, victory, and praise.

1.56.s:
sthito dhvaje vṛṣāye vā naṣṭācetpūrvato vraṇam /
siṃhegaje madhyabhāge tvantabhāge śvakākayoḥ //
1.56.d:
स्थितो ध्वजे वृषाये वा नष्टाचेत्पूर्वतो व्रणम् ।
सिंहेगजे मध्यभागे त्वन्तभागे श्वकाकयोः ॥
1.56.m: Situated in the flag or bull āya, if it is marred, the flaw is in the eastern part; / in the lion and elephant, in the middle part; but in the dog and crow, in the end part;

1.56.s:
dhṛmragarddabhayornaiva vraṇaṃ śrayontyabhāgagam /
athottarāyaṇe śukrajīvayorddaśyamānayoḥ //
1.56.d:
धृम्रगर्द्दभयोर्नैव व्रणं श्रयोन्त्यभागगम् ।
अथोत्तरायणे शुक्रजीवयोर्द्दश्यमानयोः ॥
1.56.m: in the smoke and donkey, never. A flaw in the end part brings ruin. / Now, during the northern course of the sun, when Venus and Jupiter are visible,

1.56.s:
dvijātīnāṃ gurorgehānnivṛttānāṃ yatātmanām /
citrottarāditījyāntyaharimitravidhātṛṣu //
1.56.d:
द्विजातीनां गुरोर्गेहान्निवृत्तानां यतात्मनाम् ।
चित्रोत्तरादितीज्यान्त्यहरिमित्रविधातृषु ॥
1.56.m: for twice-born men of self-control returning from the teacher's house, / under the stars Citrā, the three Uttarās, Puṣya, Revatī, Rohiṇī, Anurādhā, and Rohiṇī,

1.56.s:
bheṣvarkendujñejyaśukravāralagnāṃśakeṣu ca /
pratipatparvariktā mā cāṣṭamī ca dinatrayam //
1.56.d:
भेष्वर्केन्दुज्ञेज्यशुक्रवारलग्नांशकेषु च ।
प्रतिपत्पर्वरिक्ता मा चाष्टमी च दिनत्रयम् ॥
1.56.m: and on the weekdays, ascendants, and navāṃśas of the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, / avoiding the first tithi, parvan days, empty tithis, the new moon, the eighth tithi, and the three days,

1.56.s:
hitvānyadivase kāryaṃ samāvartanamuṇḍanam /
sarvāśramāṇāṃ viprendra hyuttamo 'yaṃ gṛhāśramaḥ //
1.56.d:
हित्वान्यदिवसे कार्यं समावर्तनमुण्डनम् ।
सर्वाश्रमाणां विप्रेन्द्र ह्युत्तमो ऽयं गृहाश्रमः ॥
1.56.m: on another day, the completion of studentship and tonsure should be performed. / O foremost of brahmins, among all stages of life, this householder stage is the highest;

1.56.s:
sukhaṃ tatrāpi bhāminyāṃ śīlavatyāṃ sthitaṃ tataḥ /
tasyāḥ sacchīlarlā dhastu sulagnavaśataḥ khalu //
1.56.d:
सुखं तत्रापि भामिन्यां शीलवत्यां स्थितं ततः ।
तस्याः सच्छीलर्ला धस्तु सुलग्नवशतः खलु ॥
1.56.m: happiness in it rests upon a virtuous wife; therefore, / the obtaining of a wife of good character indeed depends upon an auspicious ascendant.

1.56.s:
pitāmahoktaṃ saṃvīkṣya lagnaśuddhiṃ pravacmyaham /
puṇye 'hnilakṣaṇopetaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ sucetasam //
1.56.d:
पितामहोक्तं संवीक्ष्य लग्नशुद्धिं प्रवच्म्यहम् ।
पुण्ये ऽह्निलक्षणोपेतं सुखासीनं सुचेतसम् ॥
1.56.m: Having examined what was stated by Brahmā, I declare the purity of the ascendant: / On an auspicious day, approaching the astrologer who is endowed with auspicious signs, comfortably seated, and pure-minded,

1.56.s:
praṇamya devavatpṛccherddaivajñaṃ bhaktipūrvakam /
tāṃbūlaphalapuṣpādyaiḥ pūrṇāñjalirupāgataḥ //
1.56.d:
प्रणम्य देववत्पृच्छेर्द्दैवज्ञं भक्तिपूर्वकम् ।
तांबूलफलपुष्पाद्यैः पूर्णाञ्जलिरुपागतः ॥
1.56.m: having bowed to him like a deity, one should inquire with devotion, / having approached with folded hands filled with betel, fruits, flowers, and the like.

1.56.s:
tatra cellagnagaḥ krūrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ /
daṃpatyormaraṇa vācya varṣāṇāmaṣṭakātpurā //
1.56.d:
तत्र चेल्लग्नगः क्रूरस्तस्मात्सप्तमगः कुजः ।
दंपत्योर्मरण वाच्य वर्षाणामष्टकात्पुरा ॥
1.56.m: If a malefic is in the ascendant and Mars is in the seventh from it, / the death of the couple should be declared before eight years have passed.

1.56.s:
yadi lagnagataścandrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ /
vijñeyaṃ bhartṛmaraṇamaṣṭavarṣānttare budhaiḥjha //
1.56.d:
यदि लग्नगतश्चन्द्रस्तस्मात्सप्तमगः कुजः ।
विज्ञेयं भर्तृमरणमष्टवर्षान्त्तरे बुधैःझ ॥
1.56.m: If the Moon is in the ascendant and Mars is in the seventh from it, / the death of the husband within eight years should be known by the wise.

1.56.s:
lagnātpañcamagaḥ pāpaḥ śatrudṛṣṭaśca nīcagaḥ /
mṛtaputrātha vā kanyā kulaṭā vā na saṃśayaḥ //
1.56.d:
लग्नात्पञ्चमगः पापः शत्रुदृष्टश्च नीचगः ।
मृतपुत्राथ वा कन्या कुलटा वा न संशयः ॥
1.56.m: If a malefic is in the fifth from the ascendant, aspected by an enemy, and in debilitation, / the woman will have dead sons or become an unchaste woman, without doubt.

1.56.s:
tṛtīyapañcasaptāyakarmago vā niśākaraḥ /
lagnātkaroti saṃbandhaṃ daṃpatyorguruvīkṣitaḥ //
1.56.d:
तृतीयपञ्चसप्तायकर्मगो वा निशाकरः ।
लग्नात्करोति संबन्धं दंपत्योर्गुरुवीक्षितः ॥
1.56.m: Or if the Moon, situated in the third, fifth, seventh, eleventh, or tenth house / from the ascendant, is aspected by Jupiter, it brings about the union of the couple.

1.56.s:
tulāgokarkaṭā lagnasaṃsthaḥ śukrendusaṃyutāḥ /
vīkṣitāḥ pṛcchatāṃ nṝṇāṃ kanyālābho bhavettadā //
1.56.d:
तुलागोकर्कटा लग्नसंस्थः शुक्रेन्दुसंयुताः ।
वीक्षिताः पृच्छतां नॄणां कन्यालाभो भवेत्तदा ॥
1.56.m: If Libra, Taurus, or Cancer are in the ascendant, occupied by Venus and the Moon, / or aspected by them, then for men making the query, the obtaining of a maiden will take place.

1.56.s:
strīdreṣkāṇaḥ strīnavāṃśe yugmalagnaṃ samāgatam /
vīkṣitaṃ candraśukrābhyāṃ kanyālābho bhavettadā //
1.56.d:
स्त्रीद्रेष्काणः स्त्रीनवांशे युग्मलग्नं समागतम् ।
वीक्षितं चन्द्रशुक्राभ्यां कन्यालाभो भवेत्तदा ॥
1.56.m: When a female decanate is in a female navāṃśa, and a dual ascendant has arrived, / aspected by the Moon and Venus, then the obtaining of a maiden will take place.

1.56.s:
evaṃ strīṇāṃ bhartṛlabdhiḥ puṃlagne puṃnavāṃśake /
pṛcchakasya bhavellagnaṃ puṅgrahairavalokitam //
1.56.d:
एवं स्त्रीणां भर्तृलब्धिः पुंलग्ने पुंनवांशके ।
पृच्छकस्य भवेल्लग्नं पुङ्ग्रहैरवलोकितम् ॥
1.56.m: Similarly, the obtaining of a husband occurs for women when the querent's ascendant / is a male sign, in a male navāṃśa, and aspected by male planets.

1.56.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe praśnalagnādyasya rāśī yadā /
pāpadṛṣṭo 'tha vā randhre na saṃbandho bhavettadā //
1.56.d:
कृष्णपक्षे प्रश्नलग्नाद्यस्य राशी यदा ।
पापदृष्टो ऽथ वा रन्ध्रे न संबन्धो भवेत्तदा ॥
1.56.m: In the dark fortnight, whatever sign the query ascendant is in, / if it is aspected by a malefic or in the eighth house, then no alliance will take place.

1.56.s:
puṇyairnimittaśakunaiḥ praśnakāle tu maṅgalam /
daṃpatyoraśubhairetairaśubhaṃ sarvato bhavet //
1.56.d:
पुण्यैर्निमित्तशकुनैः प्रश्नकाले तु मङ्गलम् ।
दंपत्योरशुभैरेतैरशुभं सर्वतो भवेत् ॥
1.56.m: Through auspicious omens and portents at the time of query, auspiciousness ensues for the couple; / through inauspicious ones, misfortune will arise on all sides.

1.56.s:
pañcāṅgaśuddhidivase candratārābalānvite /
vivāhabhasyodaye vā kanyāvaraṇamanvayaiḥ //
1.56.d:
पञ्चाङ्गशुद्धिदिवसे चन्द्रताराबलान्विते ।
विवाहभस्योदये वा कन्यावरणमन्वयैः ॥
1.56.m: On a day pure in the five limbs of the calendar, endowed with the strength of the moon and stars, / or at the rising of the marriage-asterism, the selection of the bride should be made by relatives,

1.56.s:
bhūṣaṇaiḥ puṣpatāṃbūlaphalairgandhākṣatādibhiḥ /
śuklāṃbarairgītavādyaiṃrvighnāśīrvacanaiḥ saha //
1.56.d:
भूषणैः पुष्पतांबूलफलैर्गन्धाक्षतादिभिः ।
शुक्लांबरैर्गीतवाद्यैंर्विघ्नाशीर्वचनैः सह ॥
1.56.m: with ornaments, flowers, betel, fruits, perfumes, unbroken rice, and the like, / with white garments, songs, musical instruments, and words of obstacle-removing benediction,

1.56.s:
kārayetkanyakāgehe varaḥ praṇavapūrvakam /
tadā kuryātpitā tasyāḥ pradānaṃ prītipūrvakam //
1.56.d:
कारयेत्कन्यकागेहे वरः प्रणवपूर्वकम् ।
तदा कुर्यात्पिता तस्याः प्रदानं प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥
1.56.m: the groom should cause it to be done in the house of the maiden, preceded by the praṇava; / then her father should lovingly make the gift of her.

1.56.s:
kulaśīlavayorūpavittavidyāyutāya ca /
varāya ca rūpavatīṃ kanyāṃ dadyādyavīyasīm //
1.56.d:
कुलशीलवयोरूपवित्तविद्यायुताय च ।
वराय च रूपवतीं कन्यां दद्याद्यवीयसीम् ॥
1.56.m: To a groom endowed with good family, character, age, beauty, wealth, and learning, / he should give a beautiful maiden who is younger [than the groom].

1.56.s:
saṃpūjya prārthayitvā ca śacīṃ devīṃ guṇāśrayām /
trailokyasundarīṃ divyagandhamālyāṃbarāvṛtām //
1.56.d:
संपूज्य प्रार्थयित्वा च शचीं देवीं गुणाश्रयाम् ।
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरीं दिव्यगन्धमाल्यांबरावृताम् ॥
1.56.m: Having worshipped and prayed to Goddess Śacī, the abode of virtues, / the most beautiful in the three worlds, draped in divine perfumes, garlands, and garments,

1.56.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām /
anarghamaṇimālābhirbhāsayantīṃ digantarān //
1.56.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् ।
अनर्घमणिमालाभिर्भासयन्तीं दिगन्तरान् ॥
1.56.m: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / illuminating the quarters of the sky with necklaces of priceless gems,

1.56.s:
vilāsinīsahasrādyaiḥ sevamānāmaharniśam /
evaṃvidhāṃ kumārīṃ tāṃ pūjānte prārthayediti //
1.56.d:
विलासिनीसहस्राद्यैः सेवमानामहर्निशम् ।
एवंविधां कुमारीं तां पूजान्ते प्रार्थयेदिति ॥
1.56.m: served day and night by thousands of lovely damsels and the like; / having worshipped such a maiden, one should pray at the conclusion of worship as follows:

1.56.s:
devīndrāṇi namastubhyāṃ devendrapriyabhāmini /
vivāhe bhāgyamārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dehi me //
1.56.d:
देवीन्द्राणि नमस्तुभ्यां देवेन्द्रप्रियभामिनि ।
विवाहे भाग्यमारोग्यं पुत्रलाभं च देहि मे ॥
1.56.m: ‘O Goddess Indrāṇī, salutations to you, beloved lady of the king of gods! / In my marriage, grant me good fortune, health, and the obtaining of sons!’

1.56.s:
yugme 'bde janmataḥ strīṇāṃ pītidaṃ pāṇipīḍanam /
etatpuṃsāmayugme 'bde vyatyayenāśanaṃ tayoḥ //
1.56.d:
युग्मे ऽब्दे जन्मतः स्त्रीणां पीतिदं पाणिपीडनम् ।
एतत्पुंसामयुग्मे ऽब्दे व्यत्ययेनाशनं तयोः ॥
1.56.m: Clasping the hand in an even year from birth brings love for women; / for men, this is in an odd year; by reversal, there is destruction of both.

1.56.s:
māghaphaālgunavaiśākhajyeṣṭamāsāḥ śubhapradāḥ /
madhyamā kārtiko mārgaśīrṣo vai ninditāḥ pare //
1.56.d:
माघफआल्गुनवैशाखज्येष्टमासाः शुभप्रदाः ।
मध्यमा कार्तिको मार्गशीर्षो वै निन्दिताः परे ॥
1.56.m: The months of Māgha, Phālguna, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha bring auspiciousness; / Kārtika and Mārgaśīrṣa are mediocre; the others are indeed condemned.

1.56.s:
na kadācidvaśarkṣeṣu bhānorārdrāpraveśanāt /
vivāho devatānāṃ ca pratiṣṭāṃ copanāyanam //
1.56.d:
न कदाचिद्वशर्क्षेषु भानोरार्द्राप्रवेशनात् ।
विवाहो देवतानां च प्रतिष्टां चोपनायनम् ॥
1.56.m: Never during the asterisms of subjugation from the Sun's entry into Ārdrā / should marriage, the installation of deities, and the sacred thread ceremony be performed,

1.56.s:
nāstaṅgate site jīve na tayorbālavṛddhayoḥ /
na gurau siṃharāśisthe siṃhāṃśakagatepi vā //
1.56.d:
नास्तङ्गते सिते जीवे न तयोर्बालवृद्धयोः ।
न गुरौ सिंहराशिस्थे सिंहांशकगतेपि वा ॥
1.56.m: nor when Venus and Jupiter are combust, nor when they are in infancy or old age, / nor when Jupiter is in the sign of Leo, or in the Leo navāṃśa.

1.56.s:
paścātprāguditaḥ śukro daśatridivasaṃ śiśuḥ /
buddhaḥ pañcadinaṃ pakṣaṃ guruḥ pakṣaṃ ca sarvataḥ //
1.56.d:
पश्चात्प्रागुदितः शुक्रो दशत्रिदिवसं शिशुः ।
बुद्धः पञ्चदिनं पक्षं गुरुः पक्षं च सर्वतः ॥
1.56.m: Having risen in the west or the east, Venus is an infant for ten or three days; / when old, for five days; Jupiter is so for a fortnight on both sides.

1.56.s:
aprabuddho hṛṣīkeśo yāvattāvanna maṅgalam /
utsave vāsudevasya divase nānyamaṅgalam //
1.56.d:
अप्रबुद्धो हृषीकेशो यावत्तावन्न मङ्गलम् ।
उत्सवे वासुदेवस्य दिवसे नान्यमङ्गलम् ॥
1.56.m: As long as Hṛṣīkeśa is unawakened, no auspicious ceremony [should be held]; / on the day of the festival of Vāsudeva, no other auspicious rite [should take place].

1.56.s:
na janmamāse janmarkṣe na janmadivase 'pi ca /
ādya garbhasutasyātha duhiturvā karagrahaḥ //
1.56.d:
न जन्ममासे जन्मर्क्षे न जन्मदिवसे ऽपि च ।
आद्य गर्भसुतस्याथ दुहितुर्वा करग्रहः ॥
1.56.m: The taking of the hand (marriage) of the first-born son or daughter / must not take place in their birth-month, their birth-nakṣatra, or even on their birth-day.

1.56.s:
naivodvāho jyeṣṭhaputrīputrayośca parasparam /
jyeṣṭamāse tayorekajyeṣṭhe śreṣṭhaśca nānyathā //
1.56.d:
नैवोद्वाहो ज्येष्ठपुत्रीपुत्रयोश्च परस्परम् ।
ज्येष्टमासे तयोरेकज्येष्ठे श्रेष्ठश्च नान्यथा ॥
1.56.m: Nor should there be a marriage of an eldest daughter and an eldest son to each other / in the month of Jyeṣṭha; if only one of them is the eldest, it is auspicious, not otherwise.

1.56.s:
utpātagrahaṇādūrddhaṃ saptāhamakhilagrahe /
nākhile tridinaṃ neṣṭaṃ tridyuspṛk ca kṣayaṃ tathā //
1.56.d:
उत्पातग्रहणादूर्द्धं सप्ताहमखिलग्रहे ।
नाखिले त्रिदिनं नेष्टं त्रिद्युस्पृक् च क्षयं तथा ॥
1.56.m: Following an unnatural portentious phenomenon (utpāta) or an eclipse, seven days [must be avoided] in the case of a total eclipse; / in the case of a non-total one, three days; a day touching three tithis and an expunged tithi are likewise not favored.

1.56.s:
grastāste tridinaṃ pūrvaṃ paścādgrastodaye 'thavā /
saṃdhyāyāṃ tridinaṃ tadvanniśīthe sapta eva ca //
1.56.d:
ग्रस्तास्ते त्रिदिनं पूर्वं पश्चाद्ग्रस्तोदये ऽथवा ।
संध्यायां त्रिदिनं तद्वन्निशीथे सप्त एव च ॥
1.56.m: If it sets while eclipsed, three days prior, or if it rises while eclipsed, [three days] following; / likewise three days if during twilight, and precisely seven if at midnight.

1.56.s:
māsānte pañca divasāṃstyajedriktāṃ tathāṣṭamīm /
vyatīpātaṃ vaidhṛtiṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ parighārddhakam //
1.56.d:
मासान्ते पञ्च दिवसांस्त्यजेद्रिक्तां तथाष्टमीम् ।
व्यतीपातं वैधृतिं च संपूर्णं परिघार्द्धकम् ॥
1.56.m: One should avoid the five days at the end of a solar month, the Riktā tithis, likewise the eighth tithi, / Vyatīpāta, Vaidhṛti, and the entire first half of Parigha.

1.56.s:
pauṣṇabhatryuttarāmaitramaruñcandrārkapitryabhaiḥ /
samūlabhairaviddhaistaiḥ strīkaragraha iṣyate //
1.56.d:
पौष्णभत्र्युत्तरामैत्रमरुञ्चन्द्रार्कपित्र्यभैः ।
समूलभैरविद्धैस्तैः स्त्रीकरग्रह इष्यते ॥
1.56.m: The taking of a woman's hand is approved under Revatī, the three Uttarās, Anurādhā, / Svātī, Rohiṇī, Mṛgaśiras, Maghā, and Mūla, provided they are not pierced (aviddha).

1.56.s:
vivāhe balamāvaśyaṃ daṃpatyorgurusūryayoḥ /
cetpūjā yatnataḥ kāryā durbala grahayostayoḥ //
1.56.d:
विवाहे बलमावश्यं दंपत्योर्गुरुसूर्ययोः ।
चेत्पूजा यत्नतः कार्या दुर्बल ग्रहयोस्तयोः ॥
1.56.m: In a marriage, the planetary strength of Jupiter and the Sun for the couple is essential; / if those two planets are weak, ritual worship must be performed with effort.

1.56.s:
gocaraṃ vedhajaṃ cāṣṭavargajaṃ rūpajaṃ balam /
yathottaraṃ balādhikyaṃ sthūlaṃ gocaramārgajam //
1.56.d:
गोचरं वेधजं चाष्टवर्गजं रूपजं बलम् ।
यथोत्तरं बलाधिक्यं स्थूलं गोचरमार्गजम् ॥
1.56.m: The strength derived from transit (gocara), from planetary piercing (vedha), from the aṣṭakavarga, and natural strength (rūpaja): / in succeeding order, there is greater strength, while that derived from transit paths is rough.

1.56.s:
candratārābalaṃ vīkṣya tataḥ pañcāṅgajaṃ balam /
tithirekaguṇā vāro dviguṇastriguṇaṃ ca bham //
1.56.d:
चन्द्रताराबलं वीक्ष्य ततः पञ्चाङ्गजं बलम् ।
तिथिरेकगुणा वारो द्विगुणस्त्रिगुणं च भम् ॥
1.56.m: Having examined the strength of the Moon and the birth-star, then [consider] the strength born of the five limbs (pañcāṅga): / the tithi is of single measure, the weekday has double, and the asterism (nakṣatra) has triple;

1.56.s:
yogaścaturguṇaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ tithyarddhasaṃjñitam /
tato manahūrto balavāṃstato lagnaṃ balādhikam //
1.56.d:
योगश्चतुर्गुणः पञ्चगुणं तिथ्यर्द्धसंज्ञितम् ।
ततो मनहूर्तो बलवांस्ततो लग्नं बलाधिकम् ॥
1.56.m: The yoga has fourfold [measure], and that called half-tithi (karaṇa) has fivefold; / stronger than that is the muhūrta, and stronger than that is the ascendant (lagna);

1.56.s:
tato balavatī horā dreṣkāṇo balavāṃstataḥ /
tato navāṃśo balavāndvādaśāṃśo balī tataḥ //
1.56.d:
ततो बलवती होरा द्रेष्काणो बलवांस्ततः ।
ततो नवांशो बलवान्द्वादशांशो बली ततः ॥
1.56.m: Stronger than that is the horā, stronger than that is the decan (dreṣkāṇa); / stronger than that is the ninth-division (navāṃśa), stronger than that is the twelfth-division (dvādaśāṃśa);

1.56.s:
triṃśāṃśo balavāṃstasmādvīkṣyametadbalābalam /
śubhekṣitayutāḥ śastā udvāhe 'khilarāśayaḥ //
1.56.d:
त्रिंशांशो बलवांस्तस्माद्वीक्ष्यमेतद्बलाबलम् ।
शुभेक्षितयुताः शस्ता उद्वाहे ऽखिलराशयः ॥
1.56.m: Stronger than that is the thirtieth-division (triṃśāṃśa)—thus this strength and weakness is to be examined. / All signs aspected by or conjoined with benefic planets are auspicious in marriage.

1.56.s:
candrārkejyādayaḥ paca yasya rāśestukhecarāḥ /
iṣṭāstacchubhadaṃ lagnaṃ catvāro 'pi balānvitāḥ //
1.56.d:
चन्द्रार्केज्यादयः पच यस्य राशेस्तुखेचराः ।
इष्टास्तच्छुभदं लग्नं चत्वारो ऽपि बलान्विताः ॥
1.56.m: That sign for which five heavenly bodies, beginning with the Moon, the Sun, and Jupiter, / are auspicious—that lagna bestows good fortune, or even if four are endowed with strength.

1.56.s:
jāmitraśuddhyaikaviṃśanmahādoṣavivarjitam /
ekaviṃśatidoṣāṇāṃ nāmarūpaphalāni ca //
1.56.d:
जामित्रशुद्ध्यैकविंशन्महादोषविवर्जितम् ।
एकविंशतिदोषाणां नामरूपफलानि च ॥
1.56.m: It should be free from the twenty-one great blemishes through the purity of the seventh house (jāmitra). / The names, forms, and results of the twenty-one blemishes

1.56.s:
vakṣyante 'tra samāsena śṛṇu nārada sāṃpratam /
pañcāṅgaśuddhirāhityaṃ doṣastvādyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
1.56.d:
वक्ष्यन्ते ऽत्र समासेन शृणु नारद सांप्रतम् ।
पञ्चाङ्गशुद्धिराहित्यं दोषस्त्वाद्यः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
1.56.m: Will now be spoken here in brief; listen, O Nārada: / Lack of purity of the five limbs (pañcāṅga) is declared to be the first blemish;

1.56.s:
udayāstaśuddhirhānirdvitīyaḥ sūryasaṃkramaḥ /
tṛtīyaḥ pāpaṣaḍvargo bhṛguḥ ṣaṣṭaḥ kujo 'ṣṭamaḥ //
1.56.d:
उदयास्तशुद्धिर्हानिर्द्वितीयः सूर्यसंक्रमः ।
तृतीयः पापषड्वर्गो भृगुः षष्टः कुजो ऽष्टमः ॥
1.56.m: Loss of purity of rising and setting is the second; solar transit is the third; / malefic influence in the sixfold division (ṣaḍvarga); Venus in the sixth house; Mars in the eighth;

1.56.s:
gaṇḍāntaṃ kartarī riṣaaphaṣaḍaṣṭendugato grahaḥ /
daṃpatyoraṣṭamaṃ lagnaṃ rāśirviṣaghaṭī tathā //
1.56.d:
गण्डान्तं कर्तरी रिषअफषडष्टेन्दुगतो ग्रहः ।
दंपत्योरष्टमं लग्नं राशिर्विषघटी तथा ॥
1.56.m: Gaṇḍānta; scissors-formation (kartarī); a planet situated in the sixth or eighth from the Moon, or in the twelfth (riphpha); / the eighth lagna or eighth rāśi of the couple; likewise the poison-ghatī (viṣaghaṭī);

1.56.s:
durmuhīrto vāradoṣaḥ khārjūrikasamāṅghribham /
grahaṇotpātabhaṃ krūraviddharkṣaṃ krūrasaṃyutam //
1.56.d:
दुर्मुहीर्तो वारदोषः खार्जूरिकसमाङ्घ्रिभम् ।
